source.text: Ἐὰν δὲ ἁμαρτήσῃ εἰς σὲ ὁ ἀδελφός σου, ὕπαγε ἔλεγξον αὐτὸν μεταξὺ σοῦ καὶ αὐτοῦ μόνου.

records.literal_gloss: If but sins against you the brother of you, go reprove him between you and him alone.

en.L: And if {{gender:your brother or sister|your brother}} sins against you, go, show {{gender:them|him}} [the] fault between you and {{gender:them|him}} alone.
en.B: If {{gender:a brother or sister|your brother}} sins against you, go and confront {{gender:them|him}} about it, with only the two of you present.
en.R: If {{gender:a brother or sister|your brother}} in God's family sins against you, go and talk to {{gender:them|him}} alone. Show {{gender:them|him}} what {{gender:they|he}} did wrong.

es.L: Y si {{gender:tu hermano o hermana|tu hermano}} peca contra ti, ve, hazle ver [su] falta entre tú y {{gender:esa persona|él}} a solas.
es.B: Si {{gender:un hermano o una hermana|tu hermano}} peca contra ti, ve y hazle ver su falta a solas, entre los dos.
es.R: Si {{gender:un hermano o una hermana|tu hermano}} de la familia de Dios peca contra ti, ve y habla a solas con {{gender:esa persona|él}}. Muéstrale lo que hizo mal.

fr.L: Et si {{gender:ton frère ou ta sœur|ton frère}} pèche contre toi, va, montre-lui sa faute entre vous deux seulement.
fr.B: Si {{gender:un frère ou une sœur|ton frère}} pèche contre toi, va lui parler franchement de sa faute, seul à seul.
fr.R: Si {{gender:un frère ou une sœur|ton frère}} de la famille de Dieu pèche contre toi, va lui parler seul à seul. Montre-lui ce qu’{{gender:il ou elle|il}} a fait de mal.

sw.L: Na ndugu yako akikutendea dhambi, nenda, umwonyeshe kosa lake kati yako na yeye peke yake.
sw.B: Ndugu yako akikutendea dhambi, nenda ukamwonyeshe kosa lake mkiwa ninyi wawili peke yenu.
sw.R: Ndugu yako katika familia ya Mungu akikutendea dhambi, nenda ukaongee naye peke yake. Mwonyeshe kosa alilofanya.

vi.L: Và nếu {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} con phạm tội cùng con, hãy đi, chỉ ra lỗi của người ấy, giữa con và người ấy mà thôi.
vi.B: Nếu {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} con phạm tội với con, hãy đi gặp riêng người ấy và chỉ ra lỗi của người ấy, chỉ có hai người với nhau.
vi.R: Nếu một {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} trong gia đình của Đức Chúa Trời làm điều sai trái với con, hãy đi gặp riêng người ấy. Hãy cho người ấy thấy điều mình đã làm sai.

ko.L: 그리고 만일 네 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}가 너에게 죄를 지으면, 가서 너와 그 사람 단둘이 있는 자리에서 그의 잘못을 드러내 보여라.
ko.B: 네 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}가 너에게 죄를 짓거든, 가서 단둘이 만나 그 잘못을 깨우쳐 주어라.
ko.R: 하나님의 가족인 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}가 너에게 잘못을 하면, 그 사람을 따로 만나서 이야기하여라. 그 사람이 무엇을 잘못했는지 알려 주어라.

pt.L: E, se o seu {{gender:irmão ou irmã|irmão}} pecar contra você, vá, mostre-lhe a falta, só entre você e {{gender:essa pessoa|ele}}.
pt.B: Se o seu {{gender:irmão ou irmã|irmão}} pecar contra você, vá falar com {{gender:essa pessoa|ele}} sobre o assunto, só vocês dois.
pt.R: Se o seu {{gender:irmão ou irmã|irmão}} na família de Deus pecar contra você, vá conversar a sós com {{gender:essa pessoa|ele}}. Mostre a {{gender:essa pessoa|ele}} o que fez de errado.

am.L: {{gender:ወንድምህ ወይም እኅትህ|ወንድምህ}} ግን ኃጢአት ቢሠራብህ ሄደህ ሁለታችሁ ብቻ ባላችሁበት ስሕተቱን አሳየው።
am.B: {{gender:ወንድምህ ወይም እኅትህ|ወንድምህ}} ቢበድልህ ሄደህ ሁለታችሁ ብቻ ባላችሁበት ስሕተቱን ንገረው።
am.R: በእግዚአብሔር ቤተሰብ ውስጥ ያለ {{gender:ወንድምህ ወይም እኅትህ|ወንድምህ}} ቢበድልህ ሄደህ ለብቻው አነጋግረው። የሠራውን ስሕተት አሳየው።

ru.L: Если же {{gender:твой брат или сестра|твой брат}} согрешит против тебя, пойди, обличи этого человека между тобой и им одним.
ru.B: Если {{gender:твой брат или сестра|твой брат}} согрешит против тебя, пойди и поговори с этим человеком об этом с глазу на глаз.
ru.R: Если {{gender:брат или сестра|брат}} по Божьей семье согрешит против тебя, пойди и поговори с этим человеком наедине. Покажи, в чём этот человек неправ.

hi.L: और यदि {{gender:तुम्हारा भाई या बहन|तुम्हारा भाई}} तुम्हारे विरुद्ध पाप करे, तो जाकर उसे [उसका] दोष दिखाओ, केवल तुम्हारे और उसके बीच में।
hi.B: यदि {{gender:कोई भाई या बहन|तुम्हारा भाई}} तुम्हारे विरुद्ध पाप करे, तो जाकर उससे इस बारे में बात करो, जब केवल तुम दोनों ही हों।
hi.R: यदि परमेश्वर के परिवार में {{gender:कोई भाई या बहन|तुम्हारा भाई}} तुम्हारे विरुद्ध पाप करे, तो जाकर अकेले में उससे बात करो। उसे दिखाओ कि उसने क्या ग़लत किया।

uk.L: Якщо ж згрішить проти тебе {{gender:твій брат чи сестра|твій брат}}, іди, викрий провину між тобою і {{gender:ним чи нею|ним}} наодинці.
uk.B: Якщо {{gender:брат чи сестра|твій брат}} згрішить проти тебе, піди й поговори про це віч-на-віч, щоб були тільки ви двоє.
uk.R: Якщо {{gender:брат чи сестра|твій брат}} у Божій родині згрішить проти тебе, піди й поговори наодинці. Покажи, у чому була провина.

ja.L: もし、あなたの{{gender:きょうだい|兄弟}}があなたに対して罪を犯したなら、行って、あなたとその人と二人だけのところで、その人の過ちを示しなさい。
ja.B: もし{{gender:きょうだい|兄弟}}があなたに対して罪を犯したなら、行って、二人だけのところでそのことを指摘しなさい。
ja.R: 神の家族である{{gender:きょうだい|兄弟}}があなたに対して悪いことをしたら、その人のところに行って、二人だけで話しなさい。その人が何を間違えたのかを、はっきり示しなさい。

decisions.choice: brother: a fellow member of the community of disciples, man or woman
decisions.reason: As in 5:22-24 and 12:49-50, a brother is one who belongs to Jesus's family of disciples. The teaching applies to women as well as men.

decisions.choice: sins against you, the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: sins, without "against you", the reading of some early manuscripts
decisions.reason: Some important early manuscripts lack "against you". Without it, the teaching covers any sin of a fellow disciple, not only a wrong done to you. The words may have been added from 18:21, or dropped by a copyist. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: show the fault: bring the wrong into the open so that it is admitted
decisions.reason: The verb means to expose or convince. The aim is to win the person back (18:15), as in Leviticus 19:17.

decisions.choice: Leviticus 19:17: rebuke your neighbor, and do not hate him
decisions.reason: The law told Israel to correct a neighbor openly rather than nurse hatred in the heart.

decisions.choice: {{gender:a brother or sister|your brother}}; {{gender:them|him}}
decisions.reason: The teaching covers women and men, so the inclusive form is the default.

decisions.choice: in God's family
decisions.reason: Readable says that a fellow believer is meant.

decisions.choice: {{gender:tu hermano o hermana|tu hermano}}; {{gender:esa persona|él}}; "le" with no span
decisions.reason: The plural "hermanos" covers men and women, but the singular "tu hermano" names a man, and Jesus means any fellow disciple (meaning decision m1), so the singular takes the gender setting, as in 1 John 5:16. "Le" (hazle, muéstrale) is the same for a man or a woman, so it needs no span. The same through verse 35.

decisions.choice: {{gender:ton frère ou ta sœur|ton frère}}, with {{gender:il ou elle|il}} for the subject pronoun; "lui" with no span (for 18:15-35)
decisions.reason: As Luke 17:3: the brother is any fellow disciple, man or woman (m1). The subject pronoun that agrees with the noun goes under the same setting; the object pronoun "lui" serves either sex, so it takes none. Where the English has "between you and {{gender:them|him}} alone", French says "entre vous deux seulement" (L) and "seul à seul" (B, R), which need no setting.

decisions.choice: ndugu yako, with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Ndugu" already means a brother or a sister (meaning decision m1), and the subject prefix a- and "yeye" do not mark sex, so the English spans "brother or sister" / "brother" and "them" / "him" have nothing to change in Swahili. The same through verse 35.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}"; "người ấy" for "him", with no gender span
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 5:22 and 7:3: a fellow disciple, man or woman, is "anh chị em" by default; the pronoun "người ấy" is already inclusive.

decisions.choice: "con" for the singular "you" in 18:15-17
decisions.reason: The Greek addresses each disciple; as in Matthew 5:23-26, Jesus says "con".

decisions.choice: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} for adelphos, through Matthew 18:15-35; "그 사람", "그" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The brother is a fellow disciple, man or woman (meaning decision); the settled Korean Matthew span gives "형제자매" by default. Both forms end in a vowel, so one particle fits both. Korean refers to the person without a gendered pronoun, so the English pronoun spans have nothing to change (style guide, section 7).

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Korean, through Matthew 18:15-35; Jesus speaks in 해라체, Peter speaks to him in 합쇼체
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change (style guide, sections 4 and 7).

decisions.choice: "하나님의 가족인" (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says who the brother is, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: o seu {{gender:irmão ou irmã|irmão}}; {{gender:essa pessoa|ele}}
decisions.reason: For this chapter. The fellow disciple may be a man or a woman (m1), so the default is "irmão ou irmã", with the article and possessive outside the span since "o seu" fits both options. Portuguese pronouns are gendered, so where one is needed it goes under the same setting as "essa pessoa"; where Portuguese can leave the subject unsaid or use "lhe", which serves for both, no span is needed.

decisions.choice: {{gender:ወንድምህ ወይም እኅትህ|ወንድምህ}}; pronouns with no span
alternatives: a span on each pronoun, as in the English
decisions.reason: As the Amharic style guide sets for a fellow believer, the noun takes the gender span. The pronouns that follow are suffixes on the verb ("አሳየው", "ቢሰማህ"), whose masculine form is also the general one, so they take no span; Literal avoids the free pronoun in "between you and him" by saying "when only the two of you are there". The same holds through 18:15-35.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
alternatives: deity_pronoun spans as in the English
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Amharic and this passage carries no deity_pronoun spans.

decisions.choice: {{gender:तुम्हारा भाई या बहन|तुम्हारा भाई}}; no span on the pronouns
alternatives: spans on the pronouns too, as in the English
decisions.reason: As in the English, the inclusive form of adelphos is the default, with the possessive inside each option. Hindi वह, उसे, उसका and the subjunctive verbs are the same for a man or a woman, so the pronouns need no span; the verbs are chosen so they do not show gender. The same holds through 18:35.

decisions.choice: {{gender:твой брат или сестра|твой брат}}, and "этот человек" or a dropped subject instead of a pronoun
alternatives: pronoun spans such as "он или она"
decisions.reason: As in the English, "brother" takes the gender setting. Where the English has "they|he", Russian avoids the pronoun: it says "этот человек" or leaves the subject out ("Если послушает"), which is natural Russian and needs no setting. The same in 18:16-17 and 18:21.

decisions.choice: {{gender:твій брат чи сестра|твій брат}}, with few pronouns after it
decisions.reason: Ukrainian pronouns and past-tense verbs carry gender, so the drafts use future verbs, a dropped subject or "така людина" where English writes {{gender:they|he}}, and keep a span only where a pronoun cannot be avoided; through 18:15-21.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:きょうだい|兄弟}}" for the brother; "その人" with no span for the pronouns
decisions.reason: A fellow disciple, man or woman, is meant (m1), so the inclusive kana spelling is the default, as in the letters. The English pronoun spans (them/him) are not needed: Japanese says "その人". The same holds through 18:15-35.

decisions.choice: "過ちを示しなさい" (L); "指摘しなさい" (B)
decisions.reason: The verb means to bring the wrong into the open so that it is admitted (m3), not to scold.

source.text: ἐάν σου ἀκούσῃ, ἐκέρδησας τὸν ἀδελφόν σου·

records.literal_gloss: If you he hears, you have gained the brother of you;

en.L: If {{gender:they|he}} will listen to you, you have gained {{gender:your brother or sister|your brother}};
en.B: If {{gender:they|he}} will listen to you, you have won {{gender:your brother or sister|your brother}} back.
en.R: Maybe {{gender:they|he}} will listen to you. Then you have won {{gender:your brother or sister|your brother}} back.

es.L: Si te escucha, has ganado a {{gender:tu hermano o hermana|tu hermano}};
es.B: Si te hace caso, has recuperado a {{gender:tu hermano o hermana|tu hermano}}.
es.R: Tal vez te haga caso. Entonces habrás recuperado a {{gender:tu hermano o hermana|tu hermano}}.

fr.L: S’{{gender:il ou elle|il}} t’écoute, tu as gagné {{gender:ton frère ou ta sœur|ton frère}} ;
fr.B: S’{{gender:il ou elle|il}} t’écoute, tu auras regagné {{gender:ton frère ou ta sœur|ton frère}}.
fr.R: Peut-être qu’{{gender:il ou elle|il}} t’écoutera. Alors tu auras retrouvé {{gender:ton frère ou ta sœur|ton frère}}.

sw.L: Akikusikiliza, umejipatia ndugu yako;
sw.B: Akikusikiliza, umemrejesha ndugu yako.
sw.R: Huenda akakusikiliza. Hapo utakuwa umemrejesha ndugu yako.

vi.L: Nếu người ấy nghe con, con đã được lại {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} mình;
vi.B: Nếu người ấy chịu nghe con, con đã giành lại được {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} mình.
vi.R: Có thể người ấy sẽ nghe con. Như vậy con đã đem {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} mình trở lại.

ko.L: 그가 네 말을 들으면, 너는 네 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}를 얻은 것이다.
ko.B: 그 사람이 네 말을 들으면, 너는 네 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}를 되찾은 것이다.
ko.R: 그 사람이 네 말을 들을 수도 있다. 그러면 너는 네 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}를 다시 얻은 것이다.

pt.L: Se {{gender:essa pessoa|ele}} der ouvidos a você, você ganhou o seu {{gender:irmão ou irmã|irmão}};
pt.B: Se {{gender:essa pessoa|ele}} ouvir você, você terá ganhado de volta o seu {{gender:irmão ou irmã|irmão}}.
pt.R: Talvez {{gender:essa pessoa|ele}} ouça você. Então você ganhou de volta o seu {{gender:irmão ou irmã|irmão}}.

am.L: ቢሰማህ {{gender:ወንድምህን ወይም እኅትህን|ወንድምህን}} አተረፍክ፤
am.B: ቢሰማህ {{gender:ወንድምህን ወይም እኅትህን|ወንድምህን}} መልሰህ አገኘህ።
am.R: ምናልባት ይሰማህ ይሆናል። ከሰማህ {{gender:ወንድምህን ወይም እኅትህን|ወንድምህን}} መልሰህ አገኘህ ማለት ነው።

ru.L: Если послушает тебя, ты приобрёл {{gender:твоего брата или сестру|твоего брата}};
ru.B: Если послушает тебя, ты вернул {{gender:своего брата или сестру|своего брата}}.
ru.R: Может быть, этот человек послушает тебя. Тогда ты вернул {{gender:своего брата или сестру|своего брата}}.

hi.L: यदि वह तुम्हारी सुने, तो तुमने {{gender:अपने भाई या बहन|अपने भाई}} को पा लिया;
hi.B: यदि वह तुम्हारी बात मान ले, तो तुमने {{gender:अपने भाई या बहन|अपने भाई}} को वापस जीत लिया।
hi.R: हो सकता है वह तुम्हारी बात सुन ले। तब तुमने {{gender:अपने भाई या बहन|अपने भाई}} को वापस जीत लिया।

uk.L: Якщо послухає тебе, ти здобув {{gender:свого брата чи сестру|свого брата}};
uk.B: Якщо послухає тебе, ти повернув {{gender:свого брата чи сестру|свого брата}}.
uk.R: Можливо, тебе послухає. Тоді ти повернув {{gender:свого брата чи сестру|свого брата}}.

ja.L: もし[その人が]あなたに聞き従うなら、あなたは自分の{{gender:きょうだい|兄弟}}を得たのである。
ja.B: その人が聞き入れるなら、あなたは{{gender:きょうだい|兄弟}}を取り戻したのである。
ja.R: その人は、あなたの言うことを聞いてくれるかもしれない。そうなれば、あなたは{{gender:きょうだい|兄弟}}を取り戻したことになる。

decisions.choice: gained: won back to God and to the community
decisions.reason: The verb is a word from trade. Here what is gained is the person, brought back from the path of sin, like the sheep in 18:13.

decisions.choice: listen: heed, accept the correction
decisions.reason: To listen here is to take the correction to heart and put the wrong right.

decisions.choice: will listen
decisions.reason: The helping verb lets the gender setting change the pronoun without changing the verb.

decisions.choice: won back
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the gain is.

decisions.choice: umejipatia (you have gained for yourself) (L); umemrejesha (you have brought back) (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb is a trader's word for gain (meaning decision m1); Literal keeps that picture with "kujipatia", and Balanced and Readable say "won back", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "được lại" (L); "giành lại được" (B); "đem ... trở lại" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to gain; here it is winning a person back to God and to the community, so each level keeps the idea of "back".

decisions.choice: "얻다" (L); "되찾다" (B); "다시 얻다" (R)
decisions.reason: To gain the brother is to win him back to God and to the community (meaning decision); Balanced and Readable say "back".

source.text: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ ἀκούσῃ, παράλαβε μετὰ σοῦ ἔτι ἕνα ἢ δύο, ἵνα ἐπὶ στόματος δύο μαρτύρων ἢ τριῶν σταθῇ πᾶν ῥῆμα·

records.literal_gloss: If but not he hears, take with you yet one or two, that on mouth of two witnesses or three may be established every word;

en.L: But if {{gender:they|he}} will not listen, take one or two more with you, so that 'by [the] mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.'
en.B: If {{gender:they|he}} still will not listen, go back with one or two others, so that 'every charge may be settled on the word of two or three witnesses.'
en.R: If {{gender:they|he}} will still not listen, take one or two other people with you. The Scriptures say, 'Every charge must be proved by two or three witnesses.'

es.L: Pero si no escucha, lleva contigo todavía a uno o dos, para que “por boca de dos o tres testigos quede firme toda palabra”.
es.B: Si aun así no te hace caso, vuelve con uno o dos más, para que “todo asunto quede probado por el testimonio de dos o tres testigos”.
es.R: Si todavía no te hace caso, lleva contigo a una o dos personas más. Las Escrituras dicen: “Toda acusación tiene que ser probada por dos o tres testigos”.

fr.L: Mais s’{{gender:il ou elle|il}} n’écoute pas, prends avec toi encore une ou deux [personnes], afin que “sur la bouche de deux ou trois témoins toute parole soit établie”.
fr.B: S’{{gender:il ou elle|il}} refuse encore d’écouter, retournes-y avec une ou deux autres personnes, afin que “toute affaire soit réglée sur la parole de deux ou trois témoins”.
fr.R: S’{{gender:il ou elle|il}} ne veut toujours pas écouter, emmène avec toi une ou deux autres personnes. Les Écritures disent : “Toute accusation doit être prouvée par deux ou trois témoins.”

sw.L: Lakini asiposikiliza, chukua pamoja nawe mtu mmoja au wawili zaidi, ili 'kwa kinywa cha mashahidi wawili au watatu kila neno lithibitishwe.'
sw.B: Asipokusikiliza bado, rudi pamoja na mtu mmoja au wawili wengine, ili 'kila shtaka lithibitishwe kwa maneno ya mashahidi wawili au watatu.'
sw.R: Akikataa bado kusikiliza, chukua mtu mmoja au wawili wengine pamoja nawe. Maandiko yanasema, 'Kila shtaka lazima lithibitishwe na mashahidi wawili au watatu.'

vi.L: Nhưng nếu người ấy không nghe, hãy đem thêm một hay hai người cùng đi với con, để 'mọi lời được xác lập bởi miệng hai hay ba nhân chứng.'
vi.B: Nếu người ấy vẫn không chịu nghe, hãy đem thêm một hai người khác cùng đi với con, để 'mọi lời buộc tội được xác định dựa trên lời của hai hoặc ba nhân chứng.'
vi.R: Nếu người ấy vẫn không chịu nghe, hãy đem thêm một hai người nữa cùng đi với con. Kinh Thánh có nói: 'Mọi lời buộc tội phải được hai hoặc ba nhân chứng xác nhận.'

ko.L: 그러나 만일 그가 듣지 않으면, 한두 사람을 더 너와 함께 데리고 가거라. '두세 증인의 입으로 모든 말이 확정되게' 하려는 것이다.
ko.B: 그래도 듣지 않으면, 한두 사람을 더 데리고 가거라. '모든 일은 두세 증인의 말로 확정되어야 한다'는 말씀대로 하려는 것이다.
ko.R: 그래도 그 사람이 듣지 않으면, 다른 사람 한두 명을 함께 데리고 가거라. 성경에 '모든 일은 두세 증인의 말로 증명되어야 한다' 하고 쓰여 있다.

pt.L: Mas, se {{gender:essa pessoa|ele}} não ouvir, leve com você mais um ou dois, para que 'pela boca de duas ou três testemunhas toda palavra seja confirmada.'
pt.B: Se {{gender:essa pessoa|ele}} ainda assim não ouvir, volte lá com mais uma ou duas pessoas, para que 'toda acusação seja decidida pelo depoimento de duas ou três testemunhas.'
pt.R: Se {{gender:essa pessoa|ele}} continuar sem ouvir, leve com você mais uma ou duas pessoas. As Escrituras dizem: 'Toda acusação tem de ser provada por duas ou três testemunhas.'

am.L: ባይሰማ ግን “በሁለት ወይም በሦስት ምስክሮች አፍ ነገር ሁሉ እንዲጸና” አንድ ወይም ሁለት ሰዎች ጨምረህ ከአንተ ጋር ውሰድ።
am.B: አሁንም ባይሰማ “ክሱ ሁሉ በሁለት ወይም በሦስት ምስክሮች ቃል እንዲረጋገጥ” አንድ ወይም ሁለት ሰዎች ይዘህ ተመለስ።
am.R: አሁንም ባይሰማ አንድ ወይም ሁለት ሌሎች ሰዎችን ይዘህ ሂድ። መጽሐፍ ቅዱስ እንዲህ ይላል፦ “ክስ ሁሉ በሁለት ወይም በሦስት ምስክሮች መረጋገጥ አለበት።”

ru.L: Если же не послушает, возьми с собой ещё одного или двух, чтобы “устами двух или трёх свидетелей подтвердилось всякое слово.”
ru.B: Если и тогда не послушает, пойди снова с одним или двумя другими, чтобы “всякое обвинение было решено словом двух или трёх свидетелей.”
ru.R: Если и тогда не послушает, возьми с собой ещё одного или двух человек. Писание говорит: “Всякое обвинение должно быть доказано двумя или тремя свидетелями.”

hi.L: परंतु यदि वह न सुने, तो एक या दो और को अपने साथ ले जाओ, ताकि 'दो या तीन गवाहों के मुख से हर बात पक्की की जाए।'
hi.B: यदि वह फिर भी न सुने, तो एक या दो और लोगों को साथ लेकर फिर जाओ, ताकि 'हर आरोप का फ़ैसला दो या तीन गवाहों की बात से हो।'
hi.R: अगर वह फिर भी न सुने, तो एक या दो और लोगों को अपने साथ ले जाओ। पवित्रशास्त्र कहता है, 'हर आरोप दो या तीन गवाहों से साबित होना चाहिए।'

uk.L: Якщо ж не послухає, візьми з собою ще одного чи двох, щоб “устами двох свідків чи трьох підтверджувалося кожне слово”.
uk.B: Якщо й далі не слухатиме, піди знову з одним чи двома іншими, щоб “кожну справу вирішувати за словом двох чи трьох свідків”.
uk.R: Якщо й тоді не послухає, візьми з собою ще одну чи двох людей. У Писанні сказано: “Кожне звинувачення мусять підтвердити двоє чи троє свідків.”

ja.L: しかし、もし聞き従わないなら、ほかにもう一人か二人を一緒に連れて行きなさい。『すべてのことは、二人または三人の証人の口によって確定される』ためである。
ja.B: それでも聞き入れないなら、ほかに一人か二人を連れて、もう一度行きなさい。『すべての訴えは、二人または三人の証人の証言によって確かめられる』ようにするためである。
ja.R: それでもその人が聞かないなら、ほかに一人か二人の人と一緒に行きなさい。聖書に『どんな訴えも、二人か三人の証人によって確かめられなければならない』と書いてある。

decisions.choice: Deuteronomy 19:15: two or three witnesses
decisions.reason: The law said that a charge must be confirmed by two or three witnesses. Paul uses the same rule in 2 Corinthians 13:1.

decisions.choice: every word: every matter, every charge
decisions.reason: Like the Hebrew word it follows, the word can mean a matter or case as well as a word.

decisions.choice: so that: the others confirm what is said and help win the person
alternatives: the others serve only as a court
decisions.reason: The witnesses make sure the matter is fairly heard. They may also add their voice to the call to put things right.

decisions.choice: The Scriptures say
decisions.reason: Readable says that the words come from the law.

decisions.choice: {{gender:they|he}}
decisions.reason: As in 18:15.

decisions.choice: "xác lập" (L); "được xác định" (B); "được ... xác nhận" (R); "nhân chứng"
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 19:15 in plain modern words; "nhân chứng" is the style guide's word for witness.

decisions.choice: "두세 증인의 입으로" (L); "두세 증인의 말로" (B, R); "모든 말" (L), "모든 일" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The words of Deuteronomy 19:15 (meaning decision): "every word" is every matter or charge, and Balanced and Readable say so; Readable says that it is Scripture, as the English Readable does. "증인" is the word of the style guide (section 6).

decisions.choice: the quoted purpose clause before the command
decisions.reason: An Amharic purpose clause stands before the verb it explains, so the words from Deuteronomy 19:15 come before "take one or two with you"; the quotation itself is kept whole.

decisions.choice: the words of Deuteronomy 19:15 in 『』
decisions.reason: The words of the law stand inside Jesus's speech, so they take the inner brackets, as the English takes single quotation marks.

source.text: ἐὰν δὲ παρακούσῃ αὐτῶν, εἰπὸν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ· ἐὰν δὲ καὶ τῆς ἐκκλησίας παρακούσῃ, ἔστω σοι ὥσπερ ὁ ἐθνικὸς καὶ ὁ τελώνης.

records.literal_gloss: If but he refuses to hear them, tell to the church; if but also the church he refuses to hear, let him be to you as the Gentile and the tax collector.

en.L: And if {{gender:they|he}} will not heed them, tell [it] to the church; and if {{gender:they|he}} will not heed even the church, let {{gender:them|him}} be to you like the Gentile and the tax collector.
en.B: If {{gender:they|he}} will not hear them either, bring the matter before the church. And if {{gender:they|he}} will not hear the church either, regard {{gender:them|him}} as an outsider, like a Gentile or a tax collector.
en.R: If {{gender:they|he}} will not listen to them, tell the whole church. If {{gender:they|he}} will not listen even to the church, treat {{gender:them|him}} like someone who does not know God, or like a tax collector.

es.L: Y si no les hace caso a ellos, díselo a la iglesia; y si tampoco a la iglesia hace caso, sea para ti como el gentil y el publicano.
es.B: Si tampoco les hace caso a ellos, presenta el asunto ante la iglesia. Y si tampoco hace caso a la iglesia, considera a esa persona como alguien de fuera, como a un gentil o a un cobrador de impuestos.
es.R: Si no les hace caso a ellos, cuéntaselo a toda la iglesia. Y si ni siquiera hace caso a la iglesia, trata a esa persona como a alguien que no conoce a Dios, o como a un cobrador de impuestos.

fr.L: Et s’{{gender:il ou elle|il}} refuse de les écouter, dis-le à l’église ; et s’{{gender:il ou elle|il}} refuse d’écouter même l’église, qu’{{gender:il ou elle|il}} soit pour toi comme le païen et le collecteur d’impôts.
fr.B: S’{{gender:il ou elle|il}} ne les écoute pas non plus, porte l’affaire devant l’église. Et s’{{gender:il ou elle|il}} n’écoute pas non plus l’église, considère qu’{{gender:il ou elle|il}} ne fait plus partie des vôtres, comme un païen ou un collecteur d’impôts.
fr.R: S’{{gender:il ou elle|il}} ne les écoute pas, dis-le à toute l’église. Et s’{{gender:il ou elle|il}} n’écoute même pas l’église, alors, pour toi, {{gender:il ou elle|il}} sera comme quelqu’un qui ne connaît pas Dieu, ou comme un collecteur d’impôts.

sw.L: Na asipowasikiliza wao, liambie kanisa; na asipolisikiliza hata kanisa, na awe kwako kama mtu wa mataifa na mtoza ushuru.
sw.B: Asipowasikiliza hao pia, lipeleke jambo hilo mbele ya kanisa. Na asipolisikiliza kanisa nalo, umhesabu kuwa mtu wa nje, kama mtu wa mataifa au mtoza ushuru.
sw.R: Asipowasikiliza, waambie watu wote wa kanisa. Na asipolisikiliza hata kanisa, mtendee kama mtu asiyemjua Mungu, au kama mtoza ushuru.

vi.L: Nếu người ấy không chịu nghe họ, hãy nói với Hội Thánh; và nếu người ấy cũng không chịu nghe Hội Thánh, hãy coi người ấy như người ngoại và người thu thuế đối với con.
vi.B: Nếu người ấy không chịu nghe họ, hãy trình việc ấy với Hội Thánh. Và nếu người ấy cũng không chịu nghe Hội Thánh, hãy coi người ấy như người ngoài, như một người ngoại hay một người thu thuế.
vi.R: Nếu người ấy vẫn không chịu nghe họ, hãy nói cho cả Hội Thánh biết. Nếu người ấy cũng không chịu nghe Hội Thánh, hãy đối xử với người ấy như với một người không biết Đức Chúa Trời, hoặc như với một người thu thuế.

ko.L: 그리고 만일 그가 그들의 말을 듣지 않으면, 교회에 말하여라. 그리고 만일 교회의 말도 듣지 않으면, 그가 너에게 이방인과 세리처럼 되게 하여라.
ko.B: 그 사람이 그들의 말도 듣지 않으면, 교회에 알려라. 교회의 말까지 듣지 않으면, 그 사람을 이방 사람이나 세리처럼 공동체 밖의 사람으로 여겨라.
ko.R: 그래도 듣지 않으면, 교회 전체에 알려라. 교회의 말까지 듣지 않으면, 그 사람을 하나님을 모르는 사람이나 세리처럼 대하여라.

pt.L: E, se {{gender:essa pessoa|ele}} não der atenção a eles, conte [isso] à igreja; e, se não der atenção nem à igreja, que {{gender:essa pessoa|ele}} seja para você como o pagão e o cobrador de impostos.
pt.B: Se {{gender:essa pessoa|ele}} não ouvir nem a eles, leve o caso à igreja. E, se não ouvir nem a igreja, {{gender:trate essa pessoa|trate-o}} como alguém de fora, como um pagão ou um cobrador de impostos.
pt.R: Se {{gender:essa pessoa|ele}} não ouvir essas pessoas, conte tudo à igreja inteira. Se não ouvir nem mesmo a igreja, {{gender:trate essa pessoa|trate-o}} como alguém que não conhece a Deus, ou como um cobrador de impostos.

am.L: እነርሱንም ባይሰማ ለቤተ ክርስቲያን ንገር፤ ቤተ ክርስቲያንንም ደግሞ ባይሰማ እንደ አሕዛብ ሰውና እንደ ቀራጭ ይሁንልህ።
am.B: እነርሱንም ባይሰማ ጉዳዩን ለቤተ ክርስቲያን አቅርብ። ቤተ ክርስቲያንንም ባይሰማ እንደ ውጭ ሰው፣ እንደ አሕዛብ ሰው ወይም እንደ ቀራጭ ቁጠረው።
am.R: እነርሱንም ባይሰማ ለቤተ ክርስቲያን ሁሉ ንገር። ቤተ ክርስቲያንን እንኳ ባይሰማ እግዚአብሔርን እንደማያውቅ ሰው ወይም እንደ ቀራጭ ቁጠረው።

ru.L: Если же не послушает их, скажи церкви; а если и церкви не послушает, пусть будет для тебя как язычник и мытарь.
ru.B: Если не послушает и их, вынеси дело перед церковью. А если не послушает и церкви, считай этого человека чужим, как язычника или сборщика налогов.
ru.R: Если не послушает их, расскажи всей церкви. Если не послушает даже церковь, относись к этому человеку как к тому, кто не знает Бога, или как к сборщику налогов.

hi.L: और यदि वह उनकी बात अनसुनी करे, तो कलीसिया को बताओ; और यदि वह कलीसिया की भी अनसुनी करे, तो वह तुम्हारे लिए अन्यजाति और महसूल लेनेवाले जैसा ठहरे।
hi.B: यदि वह उनकी भी न सुने, तो मामला कलीसिया के सामने रखो। और यदि वह कलीसिया की भी न सुने, तो उसे बाहर का व्यक्ति समझो, जैसे कोई अन्यजाति या कर वसूलनेवाला।
hi.R: अगर वह उनकी भी न सुने, तो पूरी कलीसिया को बताओ। अगर वह कलीसिया की भी न सुने, तो उसके साथ ऐसा व्यवहार करो जैसे वह परमेश्वर को न जाननेवाला कोई ग़ैर-यहूदी हो, या कोई कर वसूलनेवाला।

uk.L: А якщо не послухає їх, скажи церкві; а якщо й церкви не послухає, нехай буде тобі, як язичник і митар.
uk.B: Якщо не послухає і їх, винеси справу перед церквою. А якщо не послухає й церкви, вважай таку людину чужою, як язичника чи збирача податків.
uk.R: Якщо не послухає їх, розкажи про це всій церкві. Якщо не послухає навіть церкви, стався до такої людини, як до того, хто не знає Бога, або як до збирача податків.

ja.L: もし彼らの[言うこと]にも聞き従わないなら、教会に告げなさい。もし教会[の言うこと]にも聞き従わないなら、その人をあなたにとって、異邦人や徴税人のような者としなさい。
ja.B: その人たちの言うことも聞き入れないなら、教会に申し出なさい。教会の言うことも聞き入れないなら、その人を外の者、異邦人や徴税人と同じようにみなしなさい。
ja.R: それでも聞かないなら、教会のみんなに話しなさい。教会の言うことも聞かないなら、その人を、神を知らない人や税金を集める人と同じように扱いなさい。

decisions.choice: the church: the gathered community of Jesus's disciples
decisions.reason: The word means an assembly. Jesus used it in 16:18 of the community he would build; here it is the local gathering of believers.

decisions.choice: the Gentile and the tax collector: people outside the fellowship
decisions.reason: Jews of the time kept apart from Gentiles and tax collectors at table (9:11). The one who will not repent is to be treated as outside the community. Yet Jesus himself sought out tax collectors (9:9-13; 11:19), and the parable of the sheep goes before these words.

decisions.choice: the Gentile: one outside Israel who did not worship its God
alternatives: a foreigner in a neutral sense
decisions.reason: As in 5:47 and 6:7.

decisions.choice: an outsider
decisions.reason: Balanced says what the comparison means, following the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: someone who does not know God
decisions.reason: Readable explains the word, as in 5:47.

decisions.choice: {{gender:they|he}}; {{gender:them|him}}
decisions.reason: As in 18:15.

decisions.choice: el publicano (L); un cobrador de impuestos (B, R)
decisions.reason: The term used across the New Testament drafts: Literal keeps the traditional "publicano", and Balanced and Readable say what the man did, since "publicano" is no longer an everyday word.

decisions.choice: esa persona, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English needs {{gender:them|him}}. Spanish "esa persona" names a man or a woman without choosing, so the sentence needs no span; "trátalo" would have made the person a man.

decisions.choice: l’église, lowercase
decisions.reason: The style guide writes "l’église" for one gathered community and "l’Église" for the whole body of believers. Here the disciples who know the offender are meant, gathered to hear the matter (m1), so the lowercase form fits.

decisions.choice: le païen (L), un païen (B); quelqu’un qui ne connaît pas Dieu (R)
decisions.reason: The word is an adjective for one of the nations who did not worship Israel's God (m3), and the point is that such a person stood outside the fellowship (m2). French "païen" says exactly that; "non-Juif", the style guide's word for the plural noun "Gentiles", would make the point one of birth rather than worship.

decisions.choice: mtu wa mataifa
decisions.reason: The term used across the New Testament drafts for one outside Israel (meaning decision m3). The singular "Mmataifa" exists but is rare; Readable says what it meant, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Hội Thánh", capitalised, as in Matthew 16:18
decisions.reason: The word the Vietnamese Matthew and the letters use for the gathered community of Jesus's disciples.

decisions.choice: "người ngoại" (L, B); "người không biết Đức Chúa Trời" (R) for the Gentile
decisions.reason: A single person is meant, so "người ngoại" rather than the collective "dân ngoại" of 5:47; Readable follows the sense, as in 6:7.

decisions.choice: "교회" at every level
decisions.reason: The church is the gathered community of Jesus's disciples (meaning decision); "교회" is the word every Korean reader knows for it, and Balanced adds "공동체 밖의 사람" for the outsider, as the English Balanced does.

decisions.choice: "이방인" (L); "이방 사람" (B); "하나님을 모르는 사람" (R); "세리" at every level
decisions.reason: The settled Korean Matthew forms for the Gentile; "세리" as in the Korean Matthew 5:46 and 11:19.

decisions.choice: a igreja, lowercase
decisions.reason: Here the word means the local gathering of disciples (m1), so it takes the lowercase used for one congregation (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 6).

decisions.choice: {{gender:trate essa pessoa|trate-o}}
decisions.reason: Written Portuguese takes the clitic "o" as object ("trate-o"), not "ele", so the setting covers the verb with its object.

decisions.choice: "አሕዛብ ሰው" (a man of the Gentiles)
decisions.reason: "አሕዛብ" is the Bible's word for the nations outside Israel; with "ሰው" it names one such person. Readable says what that meant, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "अन्यजाति" (L, B), "ग़ैर-यहूदी" (R); "महसूल लेनेवाला" (L), "कर वसूलनेवाला" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The terms settled for the book. Readable adds that a Gentile did not know God, as the English Readable says.

decisions.choice: "язычник и мытарь" (L); "язычник или сборщик налогов" (B); "тот, кто не знает Бога, или сборщик налогов" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled terms: "мытарь" at Literal, "сборщик налогов" at Balanced and Readable; Readable explains "язычник", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "церковь"
decisions.reason: The settled term for the gathered community of disciples, as the style guide gives it for this verse.

decisions.choice: "церква"
decisions.reason: The style guide gives "церква" for the community of Jesus's disciples here and at 16:18, since it is that community, not any gathering, that hears the case.

decisions.choice: "язичник і митар" (L); "язичник чи збирач податків" (B); "той, хто не знає Бога, ... збирач податків" (R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's words for Gentiles and tax collectors; Readable says what a Gentile was to a Jewish hearer, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "神を知らない人" (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what the word means here, one outside Israel who did not worship its God (m3), as the English Readable does; "ユダヤ人でない人" would lose the point of being outside the community.

source.text: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὅσα ἐὰν δήσητε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἔσται δεδεμένα ἐν οὐρανῷ καὶ ὅσα ἐὰν λύσητε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἔσται λελυμένα ἐν οὐρανῷ.

records.literal_gloss: Truly I say to you, as many as if you bind on the earth will be having been bound in heaven, and as many as if you loose on the earth will be having been loosed in heaven.

en.L: Truly I tell you, whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will have been loosed in heaven.
en.B: Truly I tell you, what you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and what you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.
en.R: I tell you the truth, whatever you forbid on earth will be forbidden in heaven. And whatever you allow on earth will be allowed in heaven.

es.L: En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo: todo lo que {{plural_you:aten|atéis}} en la tierra habrá sido atado en el cielo, y todo lo que {{plural_you:desaten|desatéis}} en la tierra habrá sido desatado en el cielo.
es.B: En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que lo que {{plural_you:aten|atéis}} en la tierra quedará atado en el cielo, y lo que {{plural_you:desaten|desatéis}} en la tierra quedará desatado en el cielo.
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo la verdad: lo que {{plural_you:ustedes prohíban|vosotros prohibáis}} en la tierra quedará prohibido en el cielo. Y lo que {{plural_you:permitan|permitáis}} en la tierra quedará permitido en el cielo.

fr.L: En vérité, je vous le dis, tout ce que vous lierez sur la terre aura été lié dans le ciel, et tout ce que vous délierez sur la terre aura été délié dans le ciel.
fr.B: En vérité, je vous le dis, ce que vous lierez sur la terre sera lié dans le ciel, et ce que vous délierez sur la terre sera délié dans le ciel.
fr.R: Je vous le dis, c’est la vérité : tout ce que vous interdirez sur la terre sera interdit dans le ciel. Et tout ce que vous permettrez sur la terre sera permis dans le ciel.

sw.L: Kweli nawaambia, chochote mtakachofunga duniani kitakuwa kimefungwa mbinguni, na chochote mtakachofungua duniani kitakuwa kimefunguliwa mbinguni.
sw.B: Kweli nawaambia, mtakachofunga duniani kitafungwa mbinguni, na mtakachofungua duniani kitafunguliwa mbinguni.
sw.R: Nawaambia ukweli, chochote mtakachokataza duniani kitakatazwa mbinguni. Na chochote mtakachoruhusu duniani kitaruhusiwa mbinguni.

vi.L: Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, những gì các con buộc ở dưới đất sẽ là điều đã bị buộc ở trên trời, và những gì các con mở ở dưới đất sẽ là điều đã được mở ở trên trời.
vi.B: Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, điều gì các con buộc ở dưới đất cũng sẽ bị buộc ở trên trời, và điều gì các con mở ở dưới đất cũng sẽ được mở ở trên trời.
vi.R: Ta nói thật với các con, điều gì các con cấm ở dưới đất thì trên trời cũng sẽ cấm. Và điều gì các con cho phép ở dưới đất thì trên trời cũng sẽ cho phép.

ko.L: 진실로 너희에게 말한다. 너희가 땅에서 무엇이든지 매면 하늘에서 매여 있을 것이고, 너희가 땅에서 무엇이든지 풀면 하늘에서 풀려 있을 것이다.
ko.B: 진실로 너희에게 말한다. 너희가 땅에서 매는 것은 하늘에서도 매일 것이고, 너희가 땅에서 푸는 것은 하늘에서도 풀릴 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 분명히 말한다. 너희가 땅에서 금지하는 것은 하늘에서도 금지될 것이다. 그리고 너희가 땅에서 허락하는 것은 하늘에서도 허락될 것이다.

pt.L: Em verdade eu lhes digo: tudo o que vocês ligarem na terra terá sido ligado no céu, e tudo o que vocês desligarem na terra terá sido desligado no céu.
pt.B: Em verdade eu lhes digo: o que vocês ligarem na terra será ligado no céu, e o que vocês desligarem na terra será desligado no céu.
pt.R: Eu garanto a vocês: tudo o que vocês proibirem na terra vai ser proibido no céu. E tudo o que vocês permitirem na terra vai ser permitido no céu.

am.L: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፣ በምድር ላይ የምታስሩት ሁሉ በሰማይ ታስሮ ይሆናል፤ በምድር ላይ የምትፈቱትም ሁሉ በሰማይ ተፈትቶ ይሆናል።
am.B: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፣ በምድር የምታስሩት በሰማይ የታሰረ ይሆናል፤ በምድር የምትፈቱትም በሰማይ የተፈታ ይሆናል።
am.R: እውነቱን እነግራችኋለሁ፣ በምድር ላይ የምትከለክሉት ነገር ሁሉ በሰማይም የተከለከለ ይሆናል። በምድር ላይ የምትፈቅዱት ነገር ሁሉ በሰማይም የተፈቀደ ይሆናል።

ru.L: Истинно говорю вам: что вы свяжете на земле, то будет связано на небе, и что развяжете на земле, то будет развязано на небе.
ru.B: Истинно говорю вам: что вы свяжете на земле, будет связано на небе, и что вы развяжете на земле, будет развязано на небе.
ru.R: Говорю вам правду: всё, что вы запретите на земле, будет запрещено на небе. И всё, что вы разрешите на земле, будет разрешено на небе.

hi.L: मैं तुमसे सच कहता हूँ, जो कुछ भी तुम धरती पर बाँधो, वह स्वर्ग में बाँधा जा चुका होगा, और जो कुछ भी तुम धरती पर खोलो, वह स्वर्ग में खोला जा चुका होगा।
hi.B: मैं तुमसे सच कहता हूँ, जो तुम धरती पर बाँधोगे, वह स्वर्ग में बँधा रहेगा, और जो तुम धरती पर खोलोगे, वह स्वर्ग में खुला रहेगा।
hi.R: मैं तुमसे सच कहता हूँ, जिस बात को तुम धरती पर मना करोगे, वह स्वर्ग में भी मना होगी। और जिस बात की तुम धरती पर अनुमति दोगे, उसकी स्वर्ग में भी अनुमति होगी।

uk.L: Істинно кажу вам: усе, що звʼяжете на землі, буде звʼязане на небі, і все, що розвʼяжете на землі, буде розвʼязане на небі.
uk.B: Істинно кажу вам: що ви звʼяжете на землі, те буде звʼязане на небі, і що ви розвʼяжете на землі, те буде розвʼязане на небі.
uk.R: Кажу вам правду: що ви забороните на землі, те буде заборонене на небі. І що ви дозволите на землі, те буде дозволене на небі.

ja.L: アーメン、あなたがたに言う。あなたがたが地上でつなぐものは何でも、天でつながれていることになり、あなたがたが地上で解くものは何でも、天で解かれていることになる。
ja.B: まことに、あなたがたに言っておく。あなたがたが地上でつなぐことは、天でもつながれ、地上で解くことは、天でも解かれる。
ja.R: 本当のことを言おう。あなたたちが地上でしてはいけないと決めることは、天でもしてはいけないとされる。そして、あなたたちが地上でしてもよいと決めることは、天でもしてもよいとされる。

decisions.choice: bind and loose: decide what is forbidden and what is allowed, and so whom to hold to their sin and whom to set free
decisions.reason: Jewish teachers spoke of binding and loosing when they ruled what the law forbade or allowed. Here, after 18:15-17, it covers the church's judgment on a member who sins. Compare 16:19 and John 20:23.

decisions.choice: will have been bound: heaven's verdict stands with the church's
alternatives: heaven will afterward agree with whatever the church decides
decisions.reason: The form is a future perfect. It may mean that the church's decision follows what God has already decided, or simply that God will confirm it. The grammar does not settle the order.

decisions.choice: you: the plural, the disciples together
decisions.reason: In 16:19 the same promise is made to Peter. Here the "you" is plural, and the church of 18:17 is in view.

decisions.choice: will be bound; will be loosed, as at 16:19
alternatives: will stand bound; will stand free
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the same words as at 16:19, so readers can see it is the same promise, now given to all the disciples. Literal keeps the future perfect form.

decisions.choice: forbid; allow
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of the idiom, following the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: ustedes / vosotros forms
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to the disciples together (meaning decision m3), so every plural "you" and its verb is the reader setting: ustedes (Latin America, the default) or vosotros (Spain). English has no such choice. The same through verse 20 and in verse 35.

decisions.choice: En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo (L, B); {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo la verdad (R)
decisions.reason: The New Testament rendering of the single amen, as at 16:28. "De cierto" is the older form and now sounds dated.

decisions.choice: Kweli nawaambia (L, B); Nawaambia ukweli (R)
decisions.reason: The New Testament rendering of the single amen, as at 16:28, matching John's "Kweli kweli nawaambia" for the double form.

decisions.choice: "buộc" and "mở" (L, B); "cấm" and "cho phép" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the picture of binding and loosing; Readable gives what it means, as the English Readable does. "các con" is plural: the disciples together.

decisions.choice: "매다", "풀다" (L, B); "금지하다", "허락하다" (R); "매여 있을 것이다" (L), "매일 것이다" (B)
decisions.reason: Binding and loosing is deciding what is forbidden and what is allowed (meaning decision, footnoted); Literal and Balanced keep the picture, Readable says what it means, as the English does. Literal keeps the Greek's completed state ("will have been bound") with "-여 있을 것이다".

decisions.choice: ligar; desligar
decisions.reason: "Ligar" and "desligar" are the words Portuguese readers know for this idiom; Balanced should match the Portuguese of 16:19, so readers see the same promise now given to all the disciples. Readable gives the sense, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "እውነት እላችኋለሁ" (L, B); "እውነቱን እነግራችኋለሁ" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 16:28: the word "amen" vouches for what follows, which "እውነት እላችኋለሁ" says in Amharic; Readable uses the plainer everyday phrase. Used so through 18:15-35.

decisions.choice: "ታስሮ ይሆናል", "ተፈትቶ ይሆናል" (will have been bound, loosed)
alternatives: "የታሰረ ይሆናል" (will be bound), as Balanced and 16:19
decisions.reason: The Amharic future perfect keeps the Greek's "will have been bound" at Literal, so that heaven's verdict is not made to follow the disciples' one; Balanced keeps the wording of 16:19.

decisions.choice: "मैं तुमसे सच कहता हूँ"; the wording of 16:19 at each level
decisions.reason: The settled wording for Jesus's solemn opening, at every level. The promise repeats 16:19, now to all the disciples (the Greek "you" is plural), so each level uses the same words as there.

decisions.choice: "Истинно говорю вам" (L, B); "Говорю вам правду" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for Jesus's solemn opening. The rest of the verse repeats the wording of 16:19 at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "Істинно кажу вам" (L, B); "Кажу вам правду" (R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's form for amēn legō hymin, kept the same through the Gospels.

decisions.choice: "つながれていることになり", "解かれていることになる" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the future perfect (m2) with "〜ていることになる"; Balanced uses the simple future, as the English does.

source.text: Πάλιν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐὰν δύο συμφωνήσωσιν ἐξ ὑμῶν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς περὶ παντὸς πράγματος οὗ ἐὰν αἰτήσωνται, γενήσεται αὐτοῖς παρὰ τοῦ πατρός μου τοῦ ἐν οὐρανοῖς.

records.literal_gloss: Again truly I say to you that if two agree of you on the earth about any matter which if they ask, it will be done for them by the Father of me the in heavens.

en.L: Again, truly I tell you that if two of you agree on earth about any matter that they ask, it will be done for them by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Father who [is] in [the] heavens.
en.B: And again, truly I tell you: if two of you here on earth are of one mind about anything they ask for, it will be done for them by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Father in heaven.
en.R: I tell you the truth again. Suppose two of you here on earth agree about something and ask God for it. Then {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Father in heaven will do it for them.

es.L: Otra vez, en verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que si dos de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} se ponen de acuerdo en la tierra acerca de cualquier asunto que pidan, les será hecho por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Padre que [está] en [los] cielos.
es.B: Y otra vez, en verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que si dos de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} aquí en la tierra están de acuerdo en cualquier cosa que pidan, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Padre que está en el cielo se lo concederá.
es.R: Otra vez {{plural_you:les|os}} digo la verdad. Supongamos que dos de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} aquí en la tierra se ponen de acuerdo en algo y se lo piden a Dios. Entonces {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Padre que está en el cielo lo hará por ellos.

fr.L: De nouveau, en vérité, je vous dis que si deux d’entre vous s’accordent sur la terre au sujet de toute chose qu’ils demanderont, cela leur sera fait par {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père qui [est] dans les cieux.
fr.B: Je vous le dis encore, en vérité : si deux d’entre vous, ici sur la terre, sont d’accord pour demander quoi que ce soit, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père qui est dans le ciel le leur accordera.
fr.R: Je vous le dis encore, c’est la vérité : imaginez que deux d’entre vous, ici sur la terre, soient d’accord pour demander quelque chose à Dieu. Alors {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père qui est au ciel le fera pour eux.

sw.L: Tena, kweli nawaambia kwamba ikiwa wawili kati yenu watakubaliana duniani juu ya jambo lolote watakaloomba, watafanyiwa na Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} aliye mbinguni.
sw.B: Tena, kweli nawaambia, ikiwa wawili kati yenu hapa duniani watapatana juu ya jambo lolote watakaloliomba, Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} aliye mbinguni atawafanyia.
sw.R: Tena nawaambia ukweli. Tuseme wawili kati yenu hapa duniani wanakubaliana juu ya jambo fulani, nao wanamwomba Mungu. Basi Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} aliye mbinguni atawafanyia jambo hilo.

vi.L: Lại nữa, thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con rằng nếu hai người trong các con ở dưới đất đồng lòng về bất cứ việc gì mà họ cầu xin, thì việc ấy sẽ được Cha {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, Đấng ở trên các tầng trời, làm cho họ.
vi.B: Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng nói với các con: nếu ở dưới đất này có hai người trong các con đồng lòng cầu xin bất cứ điều gì, thì Cha {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở trên trời sẽ làm điều ấy cho họ.
vi.R: Ta lại nói thật với các con: giả sử có hai người trong các con ở dưới đất này đồng ý với nhau về một điều và cùng cầu xin Đức Chúa Trời điều ấy. Thì Cha {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở trên trời sẽ làm điều ấy cho họ.

ko.L: 다시 진실로 너희에게 말한다. 너희 가운데 두 사람이 땅에서 무슨 일이든지 구하는 것에 대하여 마음을 같이하면, 하늘들에 계신 내 아버지께로부터 그들에게 이루어질 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 다시 진실로 너희에게 말한다. 너희 가운데 두 사람이 이 땅에서 한마음이 되어 무엇이든 구하면, 하늘에 계신 내 아버지께서 그들에게 그대로 이루어 주실 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 다시 분명히 말한다. 너희 가운데 두 사람이 이 땅에서 마음을 모아 하나님께 무엇을 구한다고 하자. 그러면 하늘에 계신 내 아버지께서 그 일을 이루어 주실 것이다.

pt.L: De novo, em verdade eu lhes digo que, se dois de vocês concordarem na terra a respeito de qualquer coisa que pedirem, isso lhes será feito pelo {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Pai, que [está] nos céus.
pt.B: E de novo, em verdade eu lhes digo: se dois de vocês, aqui na terra, estiverem de acordo sobre qualquer coisa que pedirem, o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Pai, que está no céu, fará isso por eles.
pt.R: Mais uma vez eu garanto a vocês: imaginem que dois de vocês, aqui na terra, combinam entre si e pedem alguma coisa a Deus. Então o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Pai, que está no céu, vai fazer isso por eles.

am.L: ደግሞም እውነት እላችኋለሁ፣ ከእናንተ ሁለቱ በምድር ላይ ስለሚለምኑት ስለ ማናቸውም ነገር ቢስማሙ በሰማያት ባለው በአባቴ ዘንድ ይደረግላቸዋል።
am.B: ደግሞም እውነት እላችኋለሁ፤ ከእናንተ ሁለቱ እዚህ በምድር ላይ ስለሚለምኑት ስለ ማንኛውም ነገር በአንድ ልብ ቢስማሙ በሰማይ ያለው አባቴ ያደርግላቸዋል።
am.R: ደግሞም እውነቱን እነግራችኋለሁ። ከእናንተ ሁለቱ እዚህ በምድር ላይ ስለ አንድ ነገር ተስማምተው እግዚአብሔርን ቢለምኑ እንበል። በሰማይ ያለው አባቴ ያን ያደርግላቸዋል።

ru.L: Ещё истинно говорю вам, что если двое из вас согласятся на земле о всяком деле, о котором попросят, будет им от {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} Отца, [который] на небесах.
ru.B: И ещё истинно говорю вам: если двое из вас здесь, на земле, будут единодушны в чём-либо, о чём попросят, {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} Отец Небесный исполнит это для них.
ru.R: И ещё говорю вам правду: допустим, двое из вас здесь, на земле, договорятся о чём-то и попросят об этом Бога. Тогда {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} Отец на небесах сделает это для них.

hi.L: फिर से, मैं तुमसे सच कहता हूँ कि धरती पर तुममें से दो यदि किसी भी विषय पर सहमत हों जिसके लिए वे विनती करें, तो वह स्वर्ग में रहनेवाले मेरे पिता के द्वारा उनके लिए पूरा किया जाएगा।
hi.B: और फिर, मैं तुमसे सच कहता हूँ: यदि यहाँ धरती पर तुममें से दो किसी भी बात के लिए एक मन होकर माँगें, तो मेरे स्वर्गीय पिता उनके लिए उसे पूरा करेंगे।
hi.R: फिर, मैं तुमसे सच कहता हूँ। मान लो यहाँ धरती पर तुममें से दो लोग किसी बात पर सहमत होते हैं और परमेश्वर से उसे माँगते हैं। तब स्वर्ग में रहनेवाले मेरे पिता उनके लिए वह कर देंगे।

uk.L: Знову істинно кажу вам, що коли двоє з вас на землі погодяться щодо будь-якої справи, про яку попросять, буде [це] їм від {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} Отця, що на небесах.
uk.B: І ще раз істинно кажу вам: якщо двоє з вас тут, на землі, будуть однодушні в будь-чому, про що просять, {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} Отець, що на небі, зробить це для них.
uk.R: Знову кажу вам правду. Припустімо, двоє з вас тут, на землі, домовляться про щось і попросять про це Бога. Тоді {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} Отець на небі зробить це для них.

ja.L: また、アーメン、あなたがたに言う。もしあなたがたのうちの二人が、地上で、願い求めるどんな事についても心を合わせるなら、それは天におられるわたしの父によって彼らのためにかなえられる。
ja.B: また、まことに、あなたがたに言っておく。あなたがたのうちの二人が、この地上で心を一つにして何かを願い求めるなら、天におられるわたしの父は、それをかなえてくださる。
ja.R: もう一度、本当のことを言おう。あなたたちのうちの二人が、この地上で心を合わせて、何かを神に願うとしよう。そうすれば、天におられるわたしの父が、それをかなえてくださる。

decisions.choice: any matter: anything they ask, including the cases the church must judge
decisions.reason: The word can mean a legal case (1 Corinthians 6:1), which fits the setting of 18:15-18. But the promise is put broadly, about anything asked.

decisions.choice: agree: be of one mind, in harmony
decisions.reason: The verb means to sound together. The disciples ask God together, in agreement.

decisions.choice: ask God for it
decisions.reason: Readable says to whom they ask.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Padre
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks of his Father, so "mi" takes the deity_pronoun setting, as the English "my" does. Spanish leaves most subject pronouns unsaid, so it has fewer spans than English through the passage.

decisions.choice: spans only on free pronouns and possessives (Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}})
decisions.reason: As in John and the rest of Matthew: Swahili marks most pronouns inside the verb, and a prefix cannot take a capital, so the deity_pronoun setting applies only to free pronouns and possessives such as "yangu" and "langu". Swahili has fewer spans than English through the passage.

decisions.choice: "Thật vậy, Ta cũng nói với các con" (B) for "Again, truly I tell you"
alternatives: "Lại nữa, thật vậy, Ta nói với các con"
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the Gospels' amen formula ("Thật vậy, Ta nói với...") and folds "again" into it as "cũng", so that it does not open with a stack of connectives.

decisions.choice: "đồng lòng" (L, B); "đồng ý với nhau" (R)
decisions.reason: To agree is to be of one mind; "đồng lòng" says it in common words.

decisions.choice: "마음을 같이하다" (L); "한마음이 되다" (B); "마음을 모으다" (R)
decisions.reason: To agree here is to be of one mind (meaning decision), not to sign an agreement; Korean says it with "마음" at every level.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans
alternatives: capitalised pronouns, as in the English setting
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change and the Hindi has no deity_pronoun spans. Respect for Jesus is shown at every level by the honorific third person and by आप when people speak to him.

source.text: οὗ γάρ εἰσιν δύο ἢ τρεῖς συνηγμένοι εἰς τὸ ἐμὸν ὄνομα, ἐκεῖ εἰμι ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν.

records.literal_gloss: Where for are two or three gathered into the my name, there I am in midst of them.

en.L: For where two or three are gathered in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, there I am in [the] middle of them."
en.B: For whenever two or three come together in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, I am there among them."
en.R: When two or three people meet together because they follow {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, I am there with them."

es.L: Porque donde hay dos o tres reunidos en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, allí estoy en medio de ellos».
es.B: Porque dondequiera que dos o tres se reúnan en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, yo estoy allí entre ellos».
es.R: Cuando dos o tres personas se reúnen porque {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} siguen, yo estoy allí con ellas».

fr.L: Car là où deux ou trois sont rassemblés en {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, je suis là au milieu d’eux. »
fr.B: Car chaque fois que deux ou trois se réunissent en {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, je suis là, parmi eux. »
fr.R: Quand deux ou trois personnes se réunissent parce qu’elles {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} suivent, je suis là avec elles. »

sw.L: Kwa maana walipo wawili au watatu waliokusanyika katika jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, hapo nipo katikati yao."
sw.B: Kwa kuwa popote wanapokutana wawili au watatu kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, nipo hapo pamoja nao."
sw.R: Watu wawili au watatu wanapokutana kwa sababu wananifuata, nipo pamoja nao."

vi.L: Vì nơi nào có hai hoặc ba người họp lại nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở đó, giữa họ."
vi.B: Vì nơi nào có hai ba người nhóm lại nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở đó với họ."
vi.R: Khi hai hoặc ba người họp lại với nhau vì họ theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở đó với họ."

ko.L: 두세 사람이 내 이름으로 모여 있는 곳, 거기에 내가 그들 가운데 있기 때문이다."
ko.B: 두세 사람이 내 이름으로 모이는 곳에는 언제나 내가 그들 가운데 있다."
ko.R: 두세 사람이 나를 따르는 사람으로서 함께 모이면, 나도 거기에 그들과 함께 있다."

pt.L: Pois onde há dois ou três reunidos em {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome, ali estou eu, no meio deles."
pt.B: Pois, sempre que dois ou três se juntam em {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome, eu estou ali com eles."
pt.R: Quando duas ou três pessoas se encontram porque {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} seguem, eu estou ali com elas."

am.L: ሁለት ወይም ሦስት በስሜ በተሰበሰቡበት በዚያ እኔ በመካከላቸው ነኝና።»
am.B: ሁለት ወይም ሦስት ሰዎች በስሜ በሚሰበሰቡበት ሁሉ እኔ በዚያ በመካከላቸው እገኛለሁና።»
am.R: ሁለት ወይም ሦስት ሰዎች እኔን ስለሚከተሉ አብረው ሲሰበሰቡ እኔ በዚያ ከእነርሱ ጋር ነኝ።»

ru.L: Ведь где двое или трое собраны в {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} имя, там {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} посреди них.»
ru.B: Ведь где двое или трое соберутся в {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} имя, там и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} среди них.»
ru.R: Когда двое или трое людей собираются вместе, потому что они следуют за {{deity_pronoun:мной|Мной}}, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} там с ними.»

hi.L: क्योंकि जहाँ कहीं दो या तीन मेरे नाम में एकत्र हैं, वहाँ उनके मध्य मैं हूँ।"
hi.B: क्योंकि जब कभी दो या तीन लोग मेरे नाम से एक साथ मिलते हैं, मैं वहाँ उनके बीच होता हूँ।"
hi.R: जब दो या तीन लोग इसलिए मिलते हैं कि वे मेरे पीछे चलते हैं, तो मैं वहाँ उनके साथ होता हूँ।"

uk.L: Бо де двоє чи троє зібрані в {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}} імʼя, там {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} посеред них.»
uk.B: Бо де двоє чи троє збираються в {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}} імʼя, там {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} серед них.»
uk.R: Коли двоє чи троє людей збираються разом, бо йдуть за {{deity_pronoun:мною|Мною}}, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} там із ними.»

ja.L: なぜなら、二人または三人がわたしの名に集められている所には、わたしもその真ん中にいるからである。」
ja.B: 二人または三人がわたしの名によって集まる所には、わたしもその中にいるのである。」
ja.R: 二人か三人の人が、わたしに従う者として一緒に集まるなら、わたしもそこにいて、その人たちと共にいるのだ。」

decisions.choice: gathered in my name: meeting as those who belong to me
alternatives: meeting while saying my name aloud
decisions.reason: As in 18:5, "in my name" names the bond with Jesus. They meet as his disciples.

decisions.choice: I am there among them: the promise of Jesus's presence
decisions.reason: Matthew opens with "God with us" (1:23) and closes with "I am with you always" (28:20). Jesus promises to be with even the smallest gathering of his disciples.

decisions.choice: for: the reason the Father hears the two
decisions.reason: The Father answers their prayer because Jesus is present with those who meet in his name.

decisions.choice: because they follow me
decisions.reason: Readable says what "in my name" means here.

decisions.choice: the quotation closes here
decisions.reason: Peter's question in 18:21 breaks into the speech, so the quotation closes here and reopens at 18:22.

decisions.choice: "vì họ theo Ta" (R) for "in my name"
decisions.reason: Readable says what meeting in his name means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "내 이름으로" (L, B); "나를 따르는 사람으로서" (R)
decisions.reason: Gathered in my name is meeting as those who belong to him (meaning decision); Readable says so, as the English Readable does.

source.text: Τότε προσελθὼν αὐτῷ ὁ Πέτρος εἶπεν· Κύριε, ποσάκις ἁμαρτήσει εἰς ἐμὲ ὁ ἀδελφός μου καὶ ἀφήσω αὐτῷ;

records.literal_gloss: Then having come to him the Peter said, Lord, how often will sin against me the brother of me and I will forgive him?

en.L: Then Peter came to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and said, "Lord, how many times will {{gender:my brother or sister|my brother}} sin against me and I forgive {{gender:them|him}}?
en.B: Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, "Lord, if {{gender:a brother or sister|my brother}} keeps on sinning against me, how many times must I forgive?
en.R: Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, "Lord, suppose {{gender:a brother or sister|my brother}} in God's family sins against me again and again. How many times should I forgive {{gender:them|him}}?

es.L: Entonces Pedro, acercándose a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, dijo: «Señor, ¿cuántas veces pecará contra mí {{gender:mi hermano o hermana|mi hermano}} y yo le perdonaré?
es.B: Entonces Pedro se acercó a Jesús y le preguntó: «Señor, si {{gender:un hermano o una hermana|mi hermano}} sigue pecando contra mí, ¿cuántas veces tengo que perdonarle?
es.R: Entonces Pedro fue a Jesús y le preguntó: «Señor, supongamos que {{gender:un hermano o una hermana|mi hermano}} de la familia de Dios peca contra mí una y otra vez. ¿Cuántas veces debo perdonarle?

fr.L: Alors Pierre, s’étant approché, {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dit : « Seigneur, combien de fois, si {{gender:mon frère ou ma sœur|mon frère}} pèche contre moi, lui pardonnerai-je ?
fr.B: Alors Pierre vint trouver Jésus et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} demanda : « Seigneur, si {{gender:un frère ou une sœur|mon frère}} ne cesse de pécher contre moi, combien de fois dois-je pardonner ?
fr.R: Alors Pierre est venu voir Jésus et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a demandé : « Seigneur, imagine qu’{{gender:un frère ou une sœur|un frère}} de la famille de Dieu pèche contre moi encore et encore. Combien de fois est-ce que je dois lui pardonner ?

sw.L: Kisha Petro akamwendea, akasema, "Bwana, ndugu yangu atanitendea dhambi mara ngapi, nami nimsamehe?
sw.B: Kisha Petro alimjia Yesu, akamwuliza, "Bwana, ndugu yangu akiendelea kunitendea dhambi, nimsamehe mara ngapi?
sw.R: Kisha Petro alimwendea Yesu, akamwuliza, "Bwana, tuseme ndugu yangu katika familia ya Mungu ananitendea dhambi tena na tena. Nimsamehe mara ngapi?

vi.L: Bấy giờ Phi-e-rơ đến gần {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và nói: "Lạy Chúa, {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} con phạm tội cùng con bao nhiêu lần thì con phải tha thứ cho người ấy?
vi.B: Bấy giờ Phi-e-rơ đến hỏi Đức Giê-xu: "Lạy Chúa, nếu {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} cứ phạm lỗi với con, thì con phải tha thứ bao nhiêu lần?
vi.R: Rồi Phi-e-rơ đến hỏi Đức Giê-xu: "Lạy Chúa, giả sử có một {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} trong gia đình của Đức Chúa Trời cứ làm điều sai trái với con hết lần này đến lần khác. Con phải tha thứ cho người ấy bao nhiêu lần?

ko.L: 그때에 베드로가 그분께 나아와 말했다. "주님, 제 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}가 저에게 죄를 지으면, 제가 몇 번이나 용서해 주어야 합니까?

vi.R: Vì thế, vương quốc thiên đàng giống như chuyện sau đây. Có một vị vua muốn các đầy tớ của mình trả lại những gì họ nợ ông.

ko.L: 이 때문에 천국은 자기 종들과 셈을 정리하려고 한 어떤 사람, 곧 왕에게 비유되었다.
ko.B: 그러므로 천국은 이런 왕과 같다. 그 왕은 자기 종들과 빚을 정산하기로 했다.
ko.R: 그래서 천국은 이런 이야기와 같다. 어떤 왕이 자기 종들에게 빌려준 돈을 갚게 하기로 했다.

pt.L: Por isso, o Reino dos céus foi comparado a um homem, um rei, que quis acertar contas com os seus escravos.
pt.B: Por isso, o Reino dos céus é como isto: um rei resolveu que era hora de acertar as contas com os seus servos.
pt.R: Então o Reino dos céus é assim: havia um rei que resolveu cobrar dos seus servos o que eles lhe deviam.

am.L: ስለዚህ መንግሥተ ሰማያት ከባሪያዎቹ ጋር ሒሳብ ሊተሳሰብ የፈለገን ንጉሥ የሆነ ሰው ትመስላለች።
am.B: ስለዚህ መንግሥተ ሰማያት ከባሪያዎቹ ጋር ሒሳቡን ሊያጣራ የወሰነን ንጉሥ ትመስላለች።
am.R: ስለዚህ የሰማይ መንግሥት እንዲህ ናት። አንድ ንጉሥ ነበረ፤ ባሪያዎቹ ያለባቸውን ዕዳ እንዲያወራርዱ ወሰነ።

ru.L: Поэтому Царство Небесное уподоблено человеку-царю, который захотел рассчитаться со своими рабами.
ru.B: Вот почему Царство Небесное похоже на это: один царь решил, что пора проверить счета своих рабов.
ru.R: Вот на что похоже Небесное Царство. Один царь решил потребовать от своих рабов, чтобы они отдали ему то, что должны.

hi.L: इस कारण स्वर्ग का राज्य उस मनुष्य, एक राजा, के समान ठहराया गया है जिसने अपने दासों से हिसाब चुकाना चाहा।
hi.B: इसीलिए स्वर्ग का राज्य ऐसा है: एक राजा ने तय किया कि अब अपने दासों का हिसाब देखने का समय आ गया है।
hi.R: तो स्वर्ग का राज्य इस तरह का है। एक राजा था। उसने तय किया कि उसके दास उसका बकाया चुकाएँ।

uk.L: Тому Царство Небесне уподібнилося до чоловіка-царя, який захотів звести рахунки зі своїми рабами.
uk.B: Ось чому Царство Небесне подібне до такого: один цар вирішив перевірити рахунки своїх рабів.
uk.R: Тож Небесне Царство подібне ось до чого. Був собі цар, який вирішив, щоб його слуги віддали йому те, що були винні.

ja.L: このゆえに、天の国は、自分の奴隷たちと決算をしようとした一人の人、すなわち王にたとえられる。
ja.B: だから、天の国は次のようにたとえられる。ある王が、しもべたちとの貸し借りを清算しようとした。
ja.R: だから、天の国は、こんな話にたとえることができる。ある王が、自分のしもべたちに貸したお金を返させようとした。

decisions.choice: because of this: the parable shows why forgiveness has no limit
alternatives: a loose link with no reason given
decisions.reason: The story explains the answer to Peter: those whom God has forgiven so much must forgive others.

decisions.choice: slaves: royal slaves, who might hold high office
decisions.reason: A king's slaves could manage large sums for him, such as the taxes of a province. They were still his property and answered to him. The word is the one for a slave.

decisions.choice: has been compared: the kingdom is like the whole story
alternatives: the kingdom is like the king himself
decisions.reason: As in 13:24, the comparison is with what happens in the story, not only with its first figure.

decisions.choice: a king, with no deity_pronoun span for him in the story
decisions.reason: The king is a figure in a parable, so the pronouns for him take no span, though he stands for God (18:35).

decisions.choice: servants
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it; the meaning decision (m2) keeps that they were owned, and Literal keeps "slave".

decisions.choice: el reino de los cielos (every level)
decisions.reason: Matthew's name for God's kingdom, the term used for it throughout Matthew. The Spanish plural "los cielos" is natural in this phrase, so every level keeps it, where English changes to "heaven" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: esclavos (L); siervos (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet and the English: Literal says what the men were, royal slaves (meaning decision m2); Balanced and Readable say "siervos", since these slaves served the king and could hold high office. Verse 25, where the man is to be sold, says "esclavo" at Readable. The same through verse 34.

decisions.choice: the parable in the passé composé at every level ("a voulu", "a ordonné"); the Greek present of 18:32 kept at Literal ("lui dit")
alternatives: passé simple at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: As the style guide settles for the New Testament (Mark 4, Luke 15): the story is part of Jesus's speech, and French tells a story in speech in the passé composé.

decisions.choice: esclaves (L); serviteurs (B, R); compagnon d’esclavage (L), compagnon de service (B) for the fellow slave
decisions.reason: The style guide's forms, as the English: Literal keeps "esclave" and Balanced and Readable say "serviteur"; the meaning decision (m2) keeps that they were owned, and Readable says "vendu comme esclave" in 18:25, where being sold is the point. "Compagnon d’esclavage" is the Literal form of Colossians 1:7.

decisions.choice: ufalme wa mbinguni (every level)
decisions.reason: Matthew's name for God's kingdom, the term used for it throughout Matthew. "Mbinguni" (in heaven) is the natural Swahili form and stands for the Greek plural at every level.

decisions.choice: watumwa (L); watumishi (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet and the English: Literal says what the men were, royal slaves (meaning decision m2); Balanced and Readable say "watumishi", since they served the king and could hold high office. Verse 25, where the man is to be sold, says "mtumwa" at Readable. The same through verse 34.

decisions.choice: "nô lệ" (L); "đầy tớ" (B, R) through the parable
decisions.reason: As settled in Matthew 10:24 and 13:27; the master and the king are "ông" and "vua", with no deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: "giống như chuyện" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 13:24: the kingdom is like the whole story, not like the king.

decisions.choice: "종" for doulos at every level, through the parable; the king takes no honorific
decisions.reason: "종" is the style guide's word for doulos (section 6); these royal slaves might hold high office (meaning decision), which "종" allows. The king is a figure in the story, so the narrator speaks of him without the honorific, while his servants speak to him in 합쇼체.

decisions.choice: "비유되었다" (L)
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Matthew 13:24: Literal keeps the passive "has been compared".

decisions.choice: "ባሪያ" at every level
alternatives: "አገልጋይ" (servant) at Balanced and Readable, as the English
decisions.reason: The Amharic style guide keeps "ባሪያ" for the Greek word at every level; here the point is that the king owns them, since one can be sold with his family (18:25). They are royal slaves, who could hold high office.

decisions.choice: "መንግሥተ ሰማያት" (L, B); "የሰማይ መንግሥት" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 16:19 and 18:1: the church name at Literal and Balanced, the plain Amharic phrase at Readable.

decisions.choice: "स्वर्ग का राज्य" at every level
decisions.reason: The term settled for the whole book.

decisions.choice: "दास" at every level
decisions.reason: The Hindi term for doulos is दास at every level; these were the king's slaves, who could be sold (18:25). Where the English Balanced and Readable say "servant", the Hindi keeps दास.

decisions.choice: plain third person for the king
alternatives: honorific, since he stands for God (18:35)
decisions.reason: The king is a figure in a parable, so the narrative speaks of him with the plain forms (उसने, वह). The slaves still address him with आप, as slaves speak to a master.

decisions.choice: "Царство Небесное" (L, B); "Небесное Царство" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled term for the book.

decisions.choice: "рабы" at every level
alternatives: "слуги", as the English Balanced and Readable have "servants"
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps "раб" at every level. These were royal slaves, owned by the king, and the debtor can be sold (18:25). The king stands for God (18:35), but as a figure in a parable his pronouns take no span, and the slaves say "ты" to him, as the style guide has for address to a ruler.

decisions.choice: "Царство Небесне" (L, B); "Небесне Царство" (R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's term for the kingdom of heaven, kept through 18:23-35.

decisions.choice: "раби" (L, B); "слуги" (R), through the parable
decisions.reason: Doulos is "раб" by the style guide; Readable uses "слуга" in this parable because it must say in 18:25 that the man is to be sold into slavery, which "раб" would make confusing.

decisions.choice: "奴隷" (L); "しもべ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English: Literal keeps slave, Balanced and Readable say servant, and the meaning decision (m2) keeps that they were owned. In 18:25 Readable says "奴隷として売る", where being sold is the point. The master (kyrios) is "主人" (L, B) and "王" (R) through the parable.
