records.literal_gloss: Having begun and he to settle was brought to him one debtor of ten thousand talents.

en.L: And when he had begun to settle, one was brought to him who was a debtor of ten thousand talents.
en.B: As he began, a man was brought before him who owed him {{units:a sum no worker could earn in a hundred thousand years|ten thousand talents}}.
en.R: As he began, a servant was brought to him who owed him {{units:a sum no worker could earn in a hundred thousand years|ten thousand talents}}. No one could ever pay back that much money.

es.L: Y cuando él comenzó a ajustarlas, le fue traído uno que era deudor de diez mil talentos.
es.B: Al comenzar, le trajeron a uno que le debía {{units:una suma que ningún trabajador ganaría en cien mil años|diez mil talentos}}.
es.R: Cuando empezó, le trajeron a un siervo que le debía {{units:una suma que ningún trabajador ganaría en cien mil años|diez mil talentos}}. Nadie podría pagar jamás tanto dinero.

fr.L: Et quand il a commencé à régler [les comptes], on lui en a amené un qui était débiteur de dix mille talents.
fr.B: Comme il commençait, on lui a amené un homme qui lui devait {{units:une somme qu’aucun ouvrier ne pourrait gagner en cent mille ans|dix mille talents}}.
fr.R: Au début, on lui a amené un serviteur qui lui devait {{units:une somme qu’aucun ouvrier ne pourrait gagner en cent mille ans|dix mille talents}}. Personne n’aurait jamais pu rembourser autant d’argent.

sw.L: Naye alipoanza kufanya hesabu, aliletewa mmoja aliyekuwa mdaiwa wa talanta elfu kumi.
sw.B: Alipoanza, aliletewa mtu mmoja aliyekuwa akidaiwa naye {{units:kiasi ambacho hakuna mfanyakazi angeweza kukipata hata kwa miaka laki moja|talanta elfu kumi}}.
sw.R: Alipoanza, aliletewa mtumishi mmoja aliyekuwa akidaiwa naye {{units:kiasi ambacho hakuna mfanyakazi angeweza kukipata hata kwa miaka laki moja|talanta elfu kumi}}. Hakuna mtu ambaye angeweza kulipa fedha nyingi kiasi hicho.

vi.L: Khi ông bắt đầu tính sổ, có người đem đến cho ông một người mắc nợ mười nghìn ta-lâng.
vi.B: Khi vua bắt đầu, người ta dẫn đến trước mặt vua một người nợ vua {{units:một số tiền mà một người làm công có làm cả trăm nghìn năm cũng không đủ trả|mười nghìn ta-lâng}}.
vi.R: Khi vua bắt đầu, người ta dẫn đến một đầy tớ nợ vua {{units:một số tiền mà một người làm công có làm cả trăm nghìn năm cũng không đủ trả|mười nghìn ta-lâng}}. Không ai có thể trả lại được một số tiền lớn như thế.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 셈을 정리하기 시작했을 때에, 만 달란트를 빚진 사람 하나가 그에게 끌려왔다.
ko.B: 정산을 시작하자, {{units:일꾼의 이십만 년 치 품삯|10,000달란트}}에 이르는 빚을 진 사람 하나가 왕 앞에 끌려왔다.
ko.R: 왕이 정산을 시작하자, 종 하나가 왕 앞에 끌려왔다. 그 종은 왕에게 {{units:일꾼이 이십만 년 동안 일해야 버는 돈|10,000달란트}}에 이르는 빚을 지고 있었다. 아무도 그렇게 많은 돈을 갚을 수 없었다.

pt.L: E, quando ele começou a acertar, foi trazido a ele um que lhe devia dez mil talentos.
pt.B: Quando ele começou, trouxeram diante dele um homem que lhe devia {{units:uma soma que nenhum trabalhador ganharia em cem mil anos|dez mil talentos}}.
pt.R: Quando ele começou, trouxeram até ele um servo que devia a ele {{units:uma soma que nenhum trabalhador ganharia em cem mil anos|dez mil talentos}}. Ninguém conseguiria pagar tanto dinheiro.

am.L: መተሳሰብም በጀመረ ጊዜ አሥር ሺህ መክሊት ዕዳ ያለበት አንድ ሰው ወደ እርሱ ቀረበለት።
am.B: ሒሳቡን ማጣራት ሲጀምር ዕዳው {{units:አንድ ሠራተኛ በመቶ ሺህ ዓመት ሠርቶ እንኳ የማያገኘው ገንዘብ|አሥር ሺህ መክሊት}} የሆነ አንድ ሰው ወደ እርሱ ቀረበለት።
am.R: ሒሳቡን ማጣራት ሲጀምር ዕዳው {{units:አንድ ሠራተኛ በመቶ ሺህ ዓመት ሠርቶ እንኳ የማያገኘው ገንዘብ|አሥር ሺህ መክሊት}} የሆነ አንድ ባሪያ ወደ እርሱ ቀረበለት። ያን ያህል ገንዘብ ማንም ሊከፍል አይችልም።

ru.L: Когда же он начал рассчитываться, к нему привели одного должника на десять тысяч талантов.
ru.B: Когда он начал, к нему привели человека, который был должен ему {{units:сумму, которую работнику не заработать и за сто тысяч лет|десять тысяч талантов}}.
ru.R: Когда он начал, к нему привели раба, который был должен ему {{units:сумму, которую работнику не заработать и за сто тысяч лет|десять тысяч талантов}}. Никто не смог бы вернуть столько денег.

hi.L: और जब वह हिसाब करने लगा, तो एक [दास] उसके सामने लाया गया जो दस हज़ार तालन्त का क़र्ज़दार था।
hi.B: जब वह हिसाब करने लगा, तो एक आदमी उसके सामने लाया गया जो उसका {{units:एक लाख वर्ष की मज़दूरी से भी ज़्यादा का|दस हज़ार तालन्त का}} क़र्ज़दार था।
hi.R: जब वह यह करने लगा, तो एक दास को उसके पास लाया गया जो उसका {{units:एक लाख वर्ष की मज़दूरी से भी ज़्यादा का|दस हज़ार तालन्त का}} क़र्ज़दार था। इतना पैसा कोई कभी नहीं चुका सकता था।

uk.L: Коли ж він почав зводити [рахунки], привели до нього одного боржника на десять тисяч талантів.
uk.B: Коли він почав, до нього привели чоловіка, який був винен йому {{units:суму, якої робітник не заробив би й за сто тисяч років|десять тисяч талантів}}.
uk.R: Коли він почав, до нього привели слугу, який був винен йому {{units:суму, якої робітник не заробив би й за сто тисяч років|десять тисяч талантів}}. Ніхто ніколи не зміг би віддати стільки грошей.

ja.L: [王が]決算を始めると、一万タラントンの負債のある者が一人、彼のもとに連れて来られた。
ja.B: 清算が始まると、{{units:約二十万年分の賃金|一万タラントン}}の借金がある者が、王の前に連れて来られた。
ja.R: 清算が始まると、一人のしもべが王のところに連れて来られた。そのしもべは、王に{{units:約二十万年分の賃金|一万タラントン}}の借金があった。だれにも、決して返せないほどのお金だった。

decisions.choice: ten thousand talents: a sum beyond counting
decisions.reason: A talent was a weight of silver worth about six thousand denarii, and a denarius was a laborer's pay for a day (20:2). Ten thousand talents was about sixty million days' wages, more than a laborer could earn in many lifetimes. Ten thousand was the largest number in common Greek use.

decisions.choice: was brought: he was made to come, perhaps under guard
decisions.reason: The passive suggests he did not come willingly.

decisions.choice: {{units:a sum no worker could earn in a hundred thousand years|ten thousand talents}}
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give a modern figure by default, with the original sum as the alternative. Literal keeps the talents.

decisions.choice: No one could ever pay back that much money.
decisions.reason: Readable says what the sum meant to the hearers.

decisions.choice: {{units:una suma que ningún trabajador ganaría en cien mil años|diez mil talentos}}
decisions.reason: As in English: the sum is beyond counting (meaning decision m1), so Balanced and Readable give it in working years by default, with the talents one tap away. Literal keeps the talents.

decisions.choice: {{units:kiasi ambacho hakuna mfanyakazi angeweza kukipata hata kwa miaka laki moja|talanta elfu kumi}}
decisions.reason: As in English: the sum is beyond counting (meaning decision m1), so Balanced and Readable give it in working years by default, with the talents as the alternative. "Laki moja" is a hundred thousand. Literal keeps the talents.

decisions.choice: "mười nghìn ta-lâng" (L, and the alternative at B, R); the size of the sum by default (B, R)
decisions.reason: "ta-lâng" is the transliteration Vietnamese Bibles use; as with the English, the default says how vast the sum was.

decisions.choice: {{units:일꾼의 이십만 년 치 품삯|10,000달란트}} (B), {{units:일꾼이 이십만 년 동안 일해야 버는 돈|10,000달란트}} (R), with "에 이르는" outside the span; "만 달란트" (L)
decisions.reason: Ten thousand talents is a sum beyond counting (meaning decision). As the Korean Mark does for denarii (6:37; 14:5), the default gives it in wages and the alternative keeps the original unit; Literal keeps the unit. The figure follows the meaning decisions: sixty million days' wages, at about twenty years' wages a talent (25:14-15), so two hundred thousand years, the same rate the Korean Readable gives at 25:15. "에 이르는" fits both forms, whatever their last letter.

decisions.choice: {{units:አንድ ሠራተኛ በመቶ ሺህ ዓመት ሠርቶ እንኳ የማያገኘው ገንዘብ|አሥር ሺህ መክሊት}}
alternatives: "አሥር ሺህ መክሊት" with no setting, as Literal
decisions.reason: Money, so there is no metric form: as in the English, the default gives the sum in a worker's earnings and the alternative keeps the Greek's "ten thousand talents" ("መክሊት", the Amharic Bible word for the talent).

decisions.choice: {{units:एक लाख वर्ष की मज़दूरी से भी ज़्यादा का|दस हज़ार तालन्त का}}
decisions.reason: Coins and sums of money have no metric form, so the default gives the value in wages and the units setting gives the original sum, as the English does. Literal keeps "दस हज़ार तालन्त". "तालन्त" is the book's word for the talent (as at 25:15), not "तोड़े"; here, as in the English, the default gives the sum in wages, since ten thousand bags of silver would hide how impossible the debt is.

decisions.choice: {{units:сумму, которую работнику не заработать и за сто тысяч лет|десять тысяч талантов}}
decisions.reason: Money has no metric form, so as in the English the default gives the sum in what a worker earns and the alternative keeps the talents. Literal keeps the talents. The same for the denarii of 18:28.

decisions.choice: {{units:約二十万年分の賃金|一万タラントン}} (B, R); Literal "一万タラントン"
alternatives: "働く人が十万年かかっても稼げないほどの額"
decisions.reason: A coin or a sum of money has no metric form, so the units span gives the sum as working time by default, as the English does, and the original talents as the alternative. Literal keeps the talents. The default uses the short pattern of the talents in 25:14-30, a talent being about twenty years' pay, so ten thousand talents is about two hundred thousand years' pay; Readable then says that no one could repay it. The same applies to the denarii of 18:28.

source.text: μὴ ἔχοντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ἀποδοῦναι ἐκέλευσεν αὐτὸν ὁ κύριος πραθῆναι καὶ τὴν γυναῖκα καὶ τὰ τέκνα καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἔχει καὶ ἀποδοθῆναι.

records.literal_gloss: Not having but he to pay, commanded him the master to be sold and the wife and the children and all as much as he has, and to be paid.

en.L: And since he did not have [the means] to pay, the master ordered him to be sold, and [his] wife and children and everything he had, and payment to be made.
en.B: He had no means of paying, so his master gave orders for him to be sold, together with his wife, his children and all he owned, to pay toward the debt.
en.R: The servant could not pay. So the king ordered that he be sold as a slave, along with his wife and children and everything he owned. The money would go toward paying what he owed.

es.L: Y como no tenía [con qué] pagar, el señor mandó que lo vendieran a él, y a la mujer y a los hijos y todo lo que tenía, y que se pagara.
es.B: Como no tenía con qué pagar, su señor ordenó que lo vendieran a él, junto con su mujer, sus hijos y todo lo que tenía, para saldar en parte la deuda.
es.R: El siervo no podía pagar. Entonces el rey ordenó que lo vendieran como esclavo, junto con su esposa, sus hijos y todo lo que tenía. Con ese dinero se pagaría parte de lo que debía.

fr.L: Et comme il n’avait pas [de quoi] rendre, le maître a ordonné qu’il soit vendu, ainsi que [sa] femme, [ses] enfants et tout ce qu’il a, et que le remboursement soit fait.
fr.B: Comme il n’avait pas les moyens de payer, son maître a donné l’ordre de le vendre, avec sa femme, ses enfants et tout ce qu’il possédait, pour rembourser une partie de la dette.
fr.R: Le serviteur ne pouvait pas payer. Alors le roi a ordonné qu’on le vende comme esclave, avec sa femme, ses enfants et tout ce qu’il avait. L’argent servirait à payer une partie de ce qu’il devait.

sw.L: Naye asipokuwa na [cha] kulipa, bwana aliamuru auzwe, yeye na mke na watoto na vyote alivyokuwa navyo, na malipo yafanyike.
sw.B: Kwa kuwa hakuwa na uwezo wa kulipa, bwana wake aliamuru auzwe pamoja na mke wake, watoto wake na vyote alivyokuwa navyo, ili sehemu ya deni ilipwe.
sw.R: Mtumishi huyo hakuweza kulipa. Basi mfalme aliamuru auzwe kuwa mtumwa, pamoja na mkewe na watoto wake na vyote alivyokuwa navyo. Fedha hizo zingetumika kulipa sehemu ya deni lake.

vi.L: Vì người ấy không có [gì] để trả, nên chủ ra lệnh bán người ấy, cả vợ, con cái và mọi thứ người ấy có, để trả nợ.
vi.B: Vì người ấy không có gì để trả, nên chủ ra lệnh bán người ấy cùng với vợ con và mọi tài sản của người ấy để trả nợ.
vi.R: Người đầy tớ ấy không thể trả nợ. Vì vậy vua ra lệnh bán người ấy làm nô lệ, cùng với vợ con và mọi thứ người ấy có. Tiền bán được sẽ dùng để trả bớt món nợ.

ko.L: 그런데 그가 갚을 [것이] 없었으므로, 주인은 그와 [그의] 아내와 자녀들과 그가 가진 모든 것을 팔아서 갚으라고 명령했다.
ko.B: 그가 갚을 길이 없자, 주인은 그 사람과 그의 아내와 자녀들과 그가 가진 모든 것을 팔아서 빚을 갚게 하라고 명령했다.
ko.R: 그 종은 빚을 갚을 수 없었다. 그래서 왕은 그 종을 노예로 팔고, 그의 아내와 자녀들과 그가 가진 모든 것도 팔라고 명령했다. 그 돈으로 빚을 조금이라도 갚게 하려는 것이었다.

pt.L: E, como ele não tinha [com que] pagar, o senhor ordenou que ele fosse vendido, e a mulher e os filhos e tudo quanto tinha, e que se pagasse [a dívida].
pt.B: Como ele não tinha com que pagar, o seu senhor mandou que ele fosse vendido, junto com a mulher, os filhos e tudo o que tinha, para abater a dívida.
pt.R: O servo não podia pagar. Então o rei mandou vendê-lo como escravo, junto com a mulher, os filhos e tudo o que ele tinha. O dinheiro serviria para pagar parte da dívida.

am.L: የሚከፍለውም ባይኖረው ጌታው እርሱና ሚስቱ ልጆቹም ያለውም ሁሉ ተሽጠው እንዲከፈል አዘዘ።
am.B: የሚከፍለው ስላልነበረው ጌታው እርሱ፣ ሚስቱ፣ ልጆቹና ያለው ሁሉ ተሽጠው ለዕዳው እንዲከፈል አዘዘ።
am.R: ባሪያው መክፈል አልቻለም። ስለዚህ ንጉሡ እርሱ ከሚስቱና ከልጆቹ ጋር፣ ያለውም ሁሉ እንዲሸጥ አዘዘ። ገንዘቡም ዕዳውን ለመክፈል ይውላል።

ru.L: А так как ему нечем было отдать, господин приказал продать его, и жену, и детей, и всё, что он имеет, и отдать [долг].
ru.B: Платить ему было нечем, и господин велел продать его вместе с женой, детьми и всем имуществом, чтобы покрыть долг.
ru.R: Раб не мог заплатить. Поэтому царь приказал продать его вместе с женой, детьми и всем, что у него было. Эти деньги пошли бы в уплату долга.

hi.L: और चूँकि उसके पास भरने को [कुछ] नहीं था, स्वामी ने आदेश दिया कि उसे और उसकी पत्नी और बच्चों और उसका सब कुछ बेचकर भुगतान किया जाए।
hi.B: उसके पास चुकाने का कोई साधन नहीं था, इसलिए उसके स्वामी ने आदेश दिया कि उसे, उसकी पत्नी, उसके बच्चों और उसकी सारी संपत्ति को बेचकर क़र्ज़ का कुछ भाग चुकाया जाए।
hi.R: वह दास पैसा नहीं चुका सका। इसलिए राजा ने आज्ञा दी कि उसे, उसकी पत्नी और बच्चों को, और उसका सब कुछ बेच दिया जाए। वह पैसा उसका क़र्ज़ चुकाने में जाता।

uk.L: А оскільки він не мав чим віддати, пан наказав продати його, і [його] дружину, і дітей, і все, що він має, і віддати [борг].
uk.B: Він не мав чим заплатити, тож пан наказав продати його разом із дружиною, дітьми й усім, що він мав, щоб покрити борг.
uk.R: Слуга не міг заплатити. Тож цар наказав продати його в рабство разом із дружиною, дітьми й усім, що він мав. Гроші мали піти на сплату боргу.

ja.L: しかし彼には返す[すべ]がなかったので、主人は、彼も、妻も、子どもたちも、持っている物もすべて売って、返済するように命じた。
ja.B: その者には返すあてがなかったので、主人は、彼自身も、妻も子どもも、持ち物もすべて売って、借金の返済に充てるように命じた。
ja.R: しもべには、返すお金がなかった。そこで王は、そのしもべを奴隷として売るように命じた。妻も子どもも、持っている物もみな売らせた。そのお金を借金の返済に充てるためだ。

decisions.choice: sold with his family: a debtor and his household could be sold into slavery
alternatives: a punishment the law of Moses required
decisions.reason: Selling a debtor and his family was known in Israel (2 Kings 4:1; Nehemiah 5:5) and across the ancient world. The sale would cover only a tiny part of such a debt.

decisions.choice: the master: the king of 18:23
decisions.reason: The word means lord or master. In the story it is the king, the slave's owner.

decisions.choice: the king
decisions.reason: Readable keeps one name for the king throughout the story.

decisions.choice: [the means]; [his]
decisions.reason: Literal brackets the words English needs.

decisions.choice: sold as a slave
decisions.reason: Readable calls the man "servant" in this parable, as the style guide has it, but keeps "slave" where the king orders him sold with his family: being sold as property is the point here (m1).

decisions.choice: el señor (L); su señor (B); el rey (R)
decisions.reason: The master is the king of verse 23 (meaning decision m2). Lowercase "señor" is the ordinary word for a master of servants; Readable names him the king, as the English does. The same through verse 34.

decisions.choice: bwana, lowercase (L, B); mfalme (R)
decisions.reason: The master is the king of verse 23 (meaning decision m2). Lowercase "bwana" is a master of servants, and keeps him distinct from "Bwana", the Lord, in Peter's question; Readable names him the king, as the English does. The same through verse 34.

decisions.choice: "chủ" (L, B); "vua" (R) for the master
decisions.reason: The master is the king of 18:23; "chủ" keeps the Greek word, Readable names him as the king, as the English Readable does. Lowercase "chủ", with no deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: "주인" (L, B), "왕" (R) for kyrios; "노예로 팔다" (R)
decisions.reason: The master is the king of 18:23 (meaning decision); "주님" is kept for God and Jesus, so the story uses "주인", and Readable says "the king" as the English does. Readable says what being sold meant.

decisions.choice: [것이]; [그의]
decisions.reason: Korean needs a noun for "to pay" and a possessive before "wife"; Literal brackets both.

decisions.choice: [com que]; a mulher, with no bracket
decisions.reason: Portuguese uses the article where English needs "his", so "a mulher" needs no bracket; "[com que]" and "[a dívida]" are words Portuguese needs that the Greek lacks.

source.text: πεσὼν οὖν ὁ δοῦλος προσεκύνει αὐτῷ λέγων· Μακροθύμησον ἐπ’ ἐμοί, καὶ πάντα ἀποδώσω σοι.

records.literal_gloss: Having fallen therefore the slave was bowing down to him saying, Be patient with me, and all I will pay to you.

en.L: So the slave fell down and was bowing before him, saying, 'Be patient with me, and I will pay you everything.'
en.B: At that the servant threw himself to the ground before him and pleaded, 'Give me time, and I will pay back all of it.'
en.R: The servant got down on his knees in front of the king and begged, 'Please be patient with me. I will pay you everything.'

es.L: Entonces el esclavo, cayendo, se postraba ante él, diciendo: “Ten paciencia conmigo, y todo te lo pagaré”.
es.B: Entonces el siervo se echó al suelo delante de él y le suplicó: “Dame tiempo, y te lo pagaré todo”.
es.R: El siervo se puso de rodillas delante del rey y le rogó: “Por favor, ten paciencia conmigo. Te pagaré todo”.

fr.L: Alors l’esclave, s’étant jeté à terre, se prosternait devant lui en disant : “Sois patient envers moi, et je te rendrai tout.”
fr.B: Le serviteur s’est alors jeté à terre devant lui et l’a supplié : “Accorde-moi un délai, et je te rembourserai tout.”
fr.R: Le serviteur s’est mis à genoux devant le roi et l’a supplié : “S’il te plaît, sois patient avec moi. Je te rendrai tout.”

sw.L: Basi yule mtumwa, akiisha kuanguka, alikuwa akimsujudia, akisema, 'Nivumilie, nami nitakulipa kila kitu.'
sw.B: Basi yule mtumishi alijitupa chini mbele yake, akamsihi, 'Nipe muda, nami nitalilipa deni lote.'
sw.R: Yule mtumishi alipiga magoti mbele ya mfalme, akamwomba, 'Tafadhali, nivumilie. Nitakulipa kila kitu.'

vi.L: Vậy người nô lệ sấp mình xuống lạy ông và nói: 'Xin chủ kiên nhẫn với tôi, tôi sẽ trả hết cho chủ.'
vi.B: Người đầy tớ ấy liền sấp mình xuống trước mặt vua mà nài xin: 'Xin chủ cho tôi thêm thời gian, tôi sẽ trả hết cho chủ.'
vi.R: Người đầy tớ quỳ xuống trước mặt vua và van xin: 'Xin chủ hãy kiên nhẫn với tôi. Tôi sẽ trả hết cho chủ.'

ko.L: 그러자 그 종이 엎드려 그에게 절하며 말했다. '저에게 참아 주십시오. 그러면 제가 모든 것을 갚아 드리겠습니다.'
ko.B: 그러자 그 종은 땅에 엎드려 왕에게 절하며 애원했다. '조금만 기다려 주십시오. 다 갚아 드리겠습니다.'
ko.R: 그 종은 왕 앞에 무릎을 꿇고 빌었다. '제발 참아 주십시오. 제가 다 갚겠습니다.'

pt.L: Então o escravo, caindo [ao chão], se prostrava diante dele, dizendo: 'Tenha paciência comigo, e eu lhe pagarei tudo.'
pt.B: Então o servo se jogou ao chão diante dele e suplicou: 'Dê-me um prazo, e eu lhe pagarei tudo.'
pt.R: O servo se ajoelhou na frente do rei e implorou: 'Por favor, tenha paciência comigo. Eu vou pagar tudo ao senhor.'

am.L: ስለዚህ ባሪያው ወድቆ እንዲህ እያለ ይሰግድለት ነበር፦ “ታገሡኝ፤ ሁሉንም እከፍልዎታለሁ።”
am.B: በዚህ ጊዜ ባሪያው በፊቱ መሬት ላይ ወድቆ እንዲህ ሲል ለመነው፦ “ጊዜ ይስጡኝ፤ ሁሉንም መልሼ እከፍልዎታለሁ።”
am.R: ባሪያውም በንጉሡ ፊት ተንበርክኮ እንዲህ ብሎ ለመነው፦ “እባክዎ ይታገሡኝ። ሁሉንም እከፍልዎታለሁ።”

ru.L: Тогда раб, пав, кланялся ему, говоря: “Потерпи меня, и я всё тебе отдам.”
ru.B: Тогда раб бросился перед ним на землю и стал умолять: “Дай мне время, и я верну всё.”
ru.R: Раб встал перед царём на колени и стал умолять: “Пожалуйста, потерпи. Я отдам тебе всё.”

hi.L: इसलिए वह दास गिरकर उसे प्रणाम करता रहा और कहता रहा, 'मुझ पर धीरज रखिए, और मैं आपका सब कुछ चुका दूँगा।'
hi.B: यह सुनकर दास उसके सामने ज़मीन पर गिर पड़ा और गिड़गिड़ाया, 'मुझे थोड़ा समय दीजिए, मैं सब कुछ लौटा दूँगा।'
hi.R: दास राजा के सामने घुटनों पर गिर पड़ा और विनती की, 'कृपया मुझ पर धीरज रखिए। मैं आपका सब कुछ चुका दूँगा।'

uk.L: Тож раб, упавши, кланявся йому, кажучи: “Будь терпеливий до мене, і я все тобі віддам.”
uk.B: Тоді раб упав перед ним на землю й благав: “Дай мені час, і я все поверну.”
uk.R: Слуга став перед царем на коліна й благав: “Будь ласка, потерпи. Я віддам тобі все.”

ja.L: それで、その奴隷はひれ伏し、[主人を]伏し拝みながら言った。『わたしを辛抱して待ってください。そうすれば、すべてをお返しします。』
ja.B: しもべは地にひれ伏して願った。『どうか待ってください。必ず全部お返しします。』
ja.R: しもべは王の前にひざまずいて、必死に頼んだ。『どうか、待ってください。全部お返しします。』

decisions.choice: was bowing: bowing low before a king
decisions.reason: The verb is used for worship and also for bowing low before a ruler, as here. The tense pictures him pleading on and on.

decisions.choice: I will pay you everything: a promise he could never keep
decisions.reason: No slave could repay such a sum (18:24). He asks for time, but the king gives far more.

decisions.choice: single quotation marks
decisions.reason: The slave's words are inside Jesus's speech, so they take inner quotation marks.

decisions.choice: pleaded (B); begged (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say how he spoke, as the bowing shows.

decisions.choice: servant
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it, and Literal keeps "slave".

decisions.choice: “ ” for words inside Jesus's speech; the servant says "tu" to the king
decisions.reason: French typography nests « » and then “ ”. The style guide uses "tu" for one person, and the servants of the parable say "tu" as people say it to Jesus; "vous" would add a court register the Greek does not mark.

decisions.choice: "chủ" for "you" and "tôi" for "I" in the servant's plea
decisions.reason: The Greek calls the king "master"; as in Matthew 13:27, servants speak to their master as "chủ" and of themselves as "tôi".

decisions.choice: The servant pleads with the king in 합쇼체 with "저", "제"
decisions.reason: A slave speaking to his royal master uses the most deferential style; the same plea returns in 18:29.

decisions.choice: "엎드려 절하다" (L, B); "무릎을 꿇다" (R)
decisions.reason: Bowing low before a king (meaning decision); the Korean Matthew keeps "경배하다" for worship (15:25 note).

decisions.choice: o senhor: tenha paciência, eu lhe pagarei (L, B); ao senhor (R)
decisions.reason: A servant speaks up to his king, so he uses the forms that go with "o senhor" (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 4); "você" would sound rude. In 18:29 one servant pleads with another, an equal, so the same words there go with "você" and Readable says "a você".

decisions.choice: "እርስዎ" (respectful you) from the slave to the king
decisions.reason: As the Amharic style guide sets, a subordinate speaks to a ruler with the respectful form; so this plea differs from the fellow slave's in 18:29 in the pronoun only, which is Amharic courtesy, not a change in what is said. The king answers with "አንተ" (18:32).

decisions.choice: "रखिए", "दीजिए": the slave says आप to the king
decisions.reason: A slave speaks to his master with आप. The same plea in 18:29 is said to an equal and so takes तुम ("रखो"), the one change Hindi makes in the echo.

decisions.choice: the servants plead in です・ます ("待ってください", "お返しします"); the king answers plainly with "おまえ" (18:32-33)
decisions.reason: A servant speaks politely to his master and the king speaks down to his servant; the same plea is given in the same words at 18:29, so readers hear the echo.

decisions.choice: 『』 for the servant's words
decisions.reason: The words are inside Jesus's speech, so they take the inner brackets, as the English takes single quotation marks.

source.text: σπλαγχνισθεὶς δὲ ὁ κύριος τοῦ δούλου ἐκείνου ἀπέλυσεν αὐτόν, καὶ τὸ δάνειον ἀφῆκεν αὐτῷ.

records.literal_gloss: Having been moved with compassion and the master of the slave that released him, and the loan forgave him.

en.L: And the master of that slave, moved with compassion, released him and forgave him the loan.
en.B: The master was moved with pity for that servant. He set him free and forgave him the debt.
en.R: The king felt sorry for the servant. So he let him go free and forgave him the whole debt.

es.L: Y el señor de aquel esclavo, movido a compasión, lo soltó y le perdonó el préstamo.
es.B: El señor tuvo compasión de aquel siervo. Lo dejó libre y le perdonó la deuda.
es.R: El rey sintió lástima del siervo. Así que lo dejó ir libre y le perdonó toda la deuda.

fr.L: Et le maître de cet esclave, ému de compassion, l’a relâché et lui a pardonné le prêt.
fr.B: Le maître a été pris de pitié pour ce serviteur. Il l’a laissé partir et lui a pardonné sa dette.
fr.R: Le roi a eu pitié du serviteur. Alors il l’a laissé partir libre et lui a pardonné toute sa dette.

sw.L: Na bwana wa mtumwa yule, akiwa ameguswa na huruma, alimwachilia, akamsamehe mkopo.
sw.B: Bwana wake alimwonea huruma mtumishi huyo. Alimwachilia huru, akamsamehe deni.
sw.R: Mfalme alimhurumia mtumishi huyo. Basi akamwachilia aende zake, akamsamehe deni lote.

vi.L: Chủ của người nô lệ ấy động lòng thương xót, thả người ấy ra và tha thứ món nợ cho người ấy.
vi.B: Chủ động lòng thương xót người đầy tớ ấy, nên thả cho người ấy về và tha thứ món nợ.
vi.R: Vua thấy thương người đầy tớ ấy. Vì vậy vua cho người ấy về tự do và tha thứ hết cả món nợ.

ko.L: 그러자 그 종의 주인은 불쌍히 여겨 그를 놓아주고 그에게 빌린 돈을 용서해 주었다.
ko.B: 주인은 그 종을 불쌍히 여겨, 그를 놓아주고 빚을 용서해 주었다.
ko.R: 왕은 그 종이 불쌍했다. 그래서 그를 놓아주고 빚을 모두 용서해 주었다.

pt.L: E o senhor daquele escravo, movido de compaixão, o soltou e lhe perdoou o empréstimo.
pt.B: O senhor teve compaixão daquele servo. Ele o deixou ir livre e lhe perdoou a dívida.
pt.R: O rei teve pena do servo. Por isso, deixou que ele fosse embora livre e perdoou toda a dívida dele.

am.L: የዚያም ባሪያ ጌታ ራራለትና ፈታው፤ ብድሩንም ይቅር አለው።
am.B: ጌታው ለዚያ ባሪያ አዘነለት። ፈታውም፤ ዕዳውንም ይቅር አለው።
am.R: ንጉሡ ለባሪያው አዘነለት። ስለዚህ ነፃ አድርጎ ለቀቀው፤ ዕዳውንም በሙሉ ይቅር አለው።

ru.L: Господин же того раба, сжалившись, отпустил его и простил ему долг.
ru.B: Господину стало жаль этого раба. Он отпустил его и простил ему долг.
ru.R: Царю стало жаль раба. Поэтому он отпустил его и простил ему весь долг.

hi.L: तब करुणा से भरकर उस दास के स्वामी ने उसे मुक्त कर दिया और उसका ऋण उसे क्षमा कर दिया।
hi.B: स्वामी को उस दास पर दया आई। उसने उसे छोड़ दिया और उसका क़र्ज़ क्षमा कर दिया।
hi.R: राजा को उस दास पर तरस आया। इसलिए उसने उसे जाने दिया और उसका सारा क़र्ज़ क्षमा कर दिया।

uk.L: Пан того раба, зглянувшись, відпустив його і простив йому позику.
uk.B: Пан змилосердився над тим рабом. Він відпустив його і простив йому борг.
uk.R: Цареві стало шкода слугу. Тож він відпустив його і простив йому весь борг.

ja.L: すると、その奴隷の主人はあわれに思って、彼を解き放ち、その貸し金を赦してやった。
ja.B: 主人はそのしもべをあわれに思って、彼を自由にし、借金を赦してやった。
ja.R: 王はしもべをかわいそうに思った。それで、しもべを自由にして、借金を全部ゆるしてやった。

decisions.choice: moved with compassion: deeply moved
decisions.reason: This is the word used of Jesus's compassion for the crowds (9:36; 14:14).

decisions.choice: the loan: the debt, spoken of as money lent
decisions.reason: Whatever the slave had received from the king, the master treats it as a loan and cancels it.

decisions.choice: forgave: the same verb as Peter's question (18:21) and 18:35
decisions.reason: The master does more than the slave asked. He does not give time; he lets the whole debt go.

decisions.choice: forgave
decisions.reason: The same word is kept at every level to tie the story to Peter's question and to 18:35.

decisions.choice: the whole debt
decisions.reason: Readable says that the debt was cancelled in full, as 18:32 says.

decisions.choice: servant
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it, and Literal keeps "slave".

decisions.choice: pardonner at every level ("lui a pardonné sa dette"), as in 18:21-22, 18:32, 18:35
decisions.reason: "Remettre une dette" is the usual French idiom, but it would break the link the English keeps with Peter's question and with 18:35 (m3). "Pardonner une dette" is good French and keeps one verb through the passage.

decisions.choice: "động lòng thương xót" (L, B); "thấy thương" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 9:36 and 14:14.

decisions.choice: "용서하다" for the debt at every level
decisions.reason: It is the verb of Peter's question (18:21) and of 18:35 (meaning decision); the Korean Matthew already says "빚을 용서하다" in 6:12, so the parable keeps the one verb. "빌린 돈" (L) keeps the Greek "loan".

decisions.choice: "불쌍히 여기다" (L, B); "불쌍했다" (R)
decisions.reason: Moved with compassion, deeply moved (meaning decision); the words of the Korean Matthew 15:32.

decisions.choice: "ይቅር አለው" (forgave him)
decisions.reason: "ይቅር ማለት" is the verb of Peter's question (18:21) and of 18:35, so the debt and the sins are forgiven with one word, as in the Greek; it is also good Amharic of a debt.

decisions.choice: "赦して" (L, B); "ゆるして" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb of Peter's question (18:21) and of 18:35 is kept, so the story stays tied to them (m3).

source.text: ἐξελθὼν δὲ ὁ δοῦλος ἐκεῖνος εὗρεν ἕνα τῶν συνδούλων αὐτοῦ ὃς ὤφειλεν αὐτῷ ἑκατὸν δηνάρια, καὶ κρατήσας αὐτὸν ἔπνιγεν λέγων· Ἀπόδος εἴ τι ὀφείλεις.

records.literal_gloss: Having gone out but the slave that found one of the fellow slaves of him who owed him a hundred denarii, and having seized him he was choking [him] saying, Pay if anything you owe.

en.L: But that slave went out and found one of his fellow slaves who owed him a hundred denarii, and seizing him, he began to choke [him], saying, 'Pay back whatever you owe.'
en.B: But no sooner had that servant left than he came upon one of his fellow servants who owed him {{units:about a hundred days' wages|a hundred denarii}}. He grabbed him by the throat. 'Pay me what you owe!' he said.
en.R: Then that servant went out and found another servant who owed him {{units:about a hundred days' wages|a hundred denarii}}. He grabbed the man and started choking him. He said, 'Pay back the money you owe me!'

es.L: Pero al salir, aquel esclavo encontró a uno de sus compañeros de esclavitud que le debía cien denarios, y sujetándolo, lo ahogaba, diciendo: “Paga, si algo debes”.
es.B: Pero en cuanto salió, aquel siervo se encontró con uno de sus compañeros, que le debía {{units:el salario de unos cien días|cien denarios}}. Lo agarró del cuello y le dijo: “¡Págame lo que me debes!”.
es.R: Luego aquel siervo salió y encontró a otro siervo que le debía {{units:el salario de unos cien días|cien denarios}}. Lo agarró y empezó a ahogarlo. Le dijo: “¡Devuélveme el dinero que me debes!”.

fr.L: Mais cet esclave, étant sorti, a trouvé un de ses compagnons d’esclavage qui lui devait cent deniers, et, l’ayant saisi, il l’étranglait en disant : “Rends ce que tu dois.”
fr.B: Mais à peine sorti, ce serviteur est tombé sur l’un de ses compagnons de service qui lui devait {{units:environ cent journées de salaire|cent deniers}}. Il l’a pris à la gorge. “Paie-moi ce que tu me dois !” lui a-t-il dit.
fr.R: Ensuite, ce serviteur est sorti et il a trouvé un autre serviteur qui lui devait {{units:environ cent journées de salaire|cent deniers}}. Il a attrapé l’homme et s’est mis à l’étrangler. Il lui a dit : “Rends-moi l’argent que tu me dois !”

sw.L: Lakini mtumwa yule alipotoka, alimkuta mmoja wa watumwa wenzake aliyekuwa akidaiwa naye dinari mia moja; akamkamata, akawa akimkaba koo, akisema, 'Lipa ikiwa unadaiwa chochote.'
sw.B: Lakini mtumishi huyo alipotoka tu, alikutana na mmoja wa watumishi wenzake aliyekuwa akidaiwa naye {{units:mshahara wa siku mia moja hivi|dinari mia moja}}. Akamkaba koo, akamwambia, 'Lipa deni lako!'
sw.R: Kisha mtumishi huyo alitoka, akamkuta mtumishi mwingine aliyekuwa akidaiwa naye {{units:mshahara wa siku mia moja hivi|dinari mia moja}}. Akamkamata, akaanza kumkaba koo. Akamwambia, 'Nilipe deni lako!'

vi.L: Nhưng người nô lệ ấy đi ra, gặp một trong những người bạn nô lệ của mình, là người nợ mình một trăm đơ-ni-ê, và nắm lấy người ấy, bóp cổ mà nói: 'Hãy trả những gì anh nợ.'
vi.B: Nhưng vừa ra khỏi đó, người đầy tớ ấy gặp một người bạn cùng làm đầy tớ, là người nợ mình {{units:khoảng một trăm ngày công|một trăm đơ-ni-ê}}. Người ấy túm lấy cổ bạn mình mà nói: 'Trả hết những gì anh nợ tôi đây!'
vi.R: Sau đó người đầy tớ ấy đi ra và gặp một đầy tớ khác, là người nợ mình {{units:khoảng một trăm ngày công|một trăm đơ-ni-ê}}. Người ấy túm lấy người kia và bắt đầu bóp cổ. Người ấy nói: 'Trả tiền anh nợ tôi đây!'

ko.L: 그러나 그 종이 나가서, 자기에게 백 데나리온을 빚진 동료 종 하나를 만났다. 그러자 그를 붙잡고 목을 조르며 말했다. '네가 빚진 것이 있으면 갚아라.'
ko.B: 그런데 그 종은 나가자마자, 자기에게 {{units:백 일 치 품삯|100데나리온}}을 빚진 동료 종 하나를 만났다. 그는 그 동료의 멱살을 잡고 말했다. '빚진 것을 갚아라!'
ko.R: 그런데 그 종이 밖에 나가서, 자기에게 {{units:백 일 동안 일해서 번 돈|100데나리온}}을 빚진 다른 종을 만났다. 그는 그 사람을 붙잡고 목을 조르기 시작했다. 그리고 말했다. '나한테 빚진 돈을 갚아라!'

pt.L: Mas aquele escravo saiu e encontrou um dos seus companheiros de escravidão, que lhe devia cem denários, e, agarrando-o, começou a sufocá-lo, dizendo: 'Pague o que você deve.'
pt.B: Mas, assim que aquele servo saiu, deu com um dos seus companheiros de serviço, que lhe devia {{units:cerca de cem dias de salário|cem denários}}. Agarrou-o pelo pescoço. 'Pague o que você me deve!', disse.
pt.R: Depois, aquele servo saiu e encontrou outro servo que devia a ele {{units:cerca de cem dias de pagamento|cem denários}}. Ele agarrou o homem e começou a sufocá-lo. Ele disse: 'Pague o dinheiro que você me deve!'

am.L: ያ ባሪያ ግን ወጥቶ መቶ ዲናር ዕዳ ያለበትን ከባልንጀሮቹ ባሪያዎች አንዱን አገኘ፤ ይዞም እንዲህ እያለ ያንቀው ጀመር፦ “ያለብህ ቢኖር ክፈል።”
am.B: ያ ባሪያ ግን ገና እንደ ወጣ {{units:የመቶ ቀን ደመወዝ ያህል|መቶ ዲናር}} ዕዳ ያለበትን ከባልንጀሮቹ ባሪያዎች አንዱን አገኘ። አንገቱን አንቆ ያዘው። “ያለብህን ክፈለኝ!” አለው።
am.R: ከዚያም ያ ባሪያ ወጥቶ {{units:የመቶ ቀን ደመወዝ ያህል|መቶ ዲናር}} ዕዳ ያለበትን ሌላ ባሪያ አገኘ። ሰውየውን ይዞ ያንቀው ጀመር። እንዲህም አለው፦ “ያለብህን ገንዘብ መልስልኝ!”

ru.L: Раб же тот, выйдя, нашёл одного из своих товарищей-рабов, который был должен ему сто денариев, и, схватив его, душил, говоря: “Отдай, если что должен.”
ru.B: Но едва этот раб вышел, как встретил одного из товарищей-рабов, который был должен ему {{units:около ста дневных заработков|сто денариев}}. Он схватил его за горло. “Отдай, что должен!” — сказал он.
ru.R: Потом этот раб вышел и нашёл другого раба, который был должен ему {{units:около ста дневных заработков|сто денариев}}. Он схватил его и начал душить. Он сказал: “Верни деньги, которые ты мне должен!”

hi.L: परंतु उस दास ने बाहर निकलकर अपने संगी दासों में से एक को पाया जो उसके सौ दीनार का क़र्ज़दार था, और उसे पकड़कर उसका गला घोंटने लगा और कहा, 'यदि तुम पर कुछ बकाया है, तो चुकाओ।'
hi.B: परंतु वह दास बाहर निकला ही था कि उसे अपना एक संगी दास मिला जो उसका {{units:लगभग सौ दिन की मज़दूरी का|सौ दीनार का}} क़र्ज़दार था। उसने उसका गला पकड़ लिया। 'जो तुम पर मेरा बकाया है, चुका दो!' उसने कहा।
hi.R: फिर वह दास बाहर गया और उसे एक दूसरा दास मिला जो उसका {{units:लगभग सौ दिन की मज़दूरी का|सौ दीनार का}} क़र्ज़दार था। उसने उस आदमी को पकड़ लिया और उसका गला दबाने लगा। उसने कहा, 'मेरा जो पैसा तुम पर बकाया है, उसे लौटा दो!'

uk.L: Вийшовши ж, той раб знайшов одного зі своїх співрабів, який був винен йому сто динаріїв, і, схопивши його, душив, кажучи: “Віддай, якщо щось винен.”
uk.B: Але щойно той раб вийшов, як натрапив на одного зі своїх товаришів-рабів, який був винен йому {{units:приблизно сто денних заробітків|сто динаріїв}}. Він схопив його за горло. “Віддай, що винен!” — сказав він.
uk.R: Потім той слуга вийшов і знайшов іншого слугу, який був винен йому {{units:приблизно сто денних заробітків|сто динаріїв}}. Він схопив того чоловіка й почав душити. Він сказав: “Віддай гроші, які ти мені винен!”

ja.L: しかし、その奴隷は出て行って、自分に百デナリオンの借りがある仲間の奴隷の一人に出会うと、彼を捕まえて首を絞めながら言った。『何か借りがあるなら返せ。』
ja.B: ところが、そのしもべは外に出るとすぐ、自分に{{units:約百日分の賃金|百デナリオン}}を借りている仲間のしもべに出会った。彼はその仲間の首をつかみ、『借りているものを返せ！』と言った。
ja.R: それから、そのしもべは出て行って、自分に{{units:約百日分の賃金|百デナリオン}}を借りているほかのしもべを見つけた。そして、その人をつかまえて首を絞め、『わたしに借りている金を返せ！』と言った。

decisions.choice: a hundred denarii: about a hundred days' wages
decisions.reason: A denarius was a laborer's pay for a day (20:2). A hundred denarii was a real debt, a third of a year's wages, but next to ten thousand talents it was almost nothing.

decisions.choice: pay if you owe anything: pay what you owe
alternatives: a doubt about whether he owes anything
decisions.reason: The "if" does not question the debt. It is a harsh demand for whatever is owed.

decisions.choice: was choking: began to choke him
decisions.reason: The tense pictures the action going on or beginning.

decisions.choice: {{units:about a hundred days' wages|a hundred denarii}}
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give a modern figure by default, with the original sum as the alternative. Literal keeps the denarii.

decisions.choice: fellow servants (B); another servant (R)
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it; the man is in the same position as the first, owned by the king, and Literal keeps "fellow slaves".

decisions.choice: {{units:el salario de unos cien días|cien denarios}}
decisions.reason: As in English and as at John 6:7: a denarius was a day's wage (meaning decision m1), so Balanced and Readable give the sum in days' wages by default, with the coins one tap away. Literal keeps the coins.

decisions.choice: {{units:mshahara wa siku mia moja hivi|dinari mia moja}}
decisions.reason: As in English and as at John 6:7: a denarius was a day's wage (meaning decision m1), so Balanced and Readable give the sum in days' wages by default, with the coins as the alternative. Literal keeps the coins.

decisions.choice: "một trăm đơ-ni-ê" (L, and the alternative at B, R); {{units:khoảng một trăm ngày công|...}} by default (B, R)
decisions.reason: "đơ-ni-ê" is the form the Vietnamese Mark uses (6:37, 14:5); the default gives the value in days' wages, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "anh" and "tôi" between the two servants
decisions.reason: They are equals; the harshness is in the act and the command, not in a crude pronoun.

decisions.choice: {{units:백 일 치 품삯|100데나리온}} (B), {{units:백 일 동안 일해서 번 돈|100데나리온}} (R); "백 데나리온" (L)
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 6:37 and 14:5: the default gives the sum in days' wages (meaning decision), the alternative keeps the coin; Literal keeps the coin. Both forms end in a consonant, so "을" fits both.

decisions.choice: The servant speaks to his fellow servant in 해라체
decisions.reason: A creditor seizing a debtor of his own rank speaks plainly and roughly.

decisions.choice: companheiros de escravidão (L); companheiros de serviço (B)
decisions.reason: "Conservo" is the old church word and is no longer understood; Portuguese says "companheiro" with the word that matches "escravo" (L) or "servo" (B).

decisions.choice: {{units:የመቶ ቀን ደመወዝ ያህል|መቶ ዲናር}} (about a hundred days' wages; a hundred denarii)
alternatives: "መቶ ዲናር" with no setting, as Literal
decisions.reason: Money, so there is no metric form: as in the English, the default gives the sum in days' wages and the alternative keeps the coin.

decisions.choice: {{units:लगभग सौ दिन की मज़दूरी का|सौ दीनार का}}
decisions.reason: The default gives the value in wages and the units setting gives the coin, as the English does. Literal keeps "सौ दीनार".

decisions.choice: "співраб" (L); "товариш-раб" (B); "інший слуга" (R)
decisions.reason: Syndoulos is a slave of the same master; Literal keeps the compound, Balanced spells it out, and Readable follows its "слуга" for the parable.

source.text: πεσὼν οὖν ὁ σύνδουλος αὐτοῦ παρεκάλει αὐτὸν λέγων· Μακροθύμησον ἐπ’ ἐμοί, καὶ ἀποδώσω σοι.

records.literal_gloss: Having fallen therefore the fellow slave of him was begging him saying, Be patient with me, and I will pay you.

en.L: So his fellow slave fell down and was begging him, saying, 'Be patient with me, and I will pay you.'
en.B: His fellow servant dropped to the ground and pleaded with him, 'Give me time, and I will pay you back.'
en.R: The other servant got down on his knees and begged him, 'Please be patient with me. I will pay you back.'

es.L: Entonces su compañero de esclavitud, cayendo, le suplicaba, diciendo: “Ten paciencia conmigo, y te pagaré”.
es.B: Su compañero se echó al suelo y le suplicó: “Dame tiempo, y te lo pagaré”.
es.R: El otro siervo se puso de rodillas y le rogó: “Por favor, ten paciencia conmigo. Te pagaré”.

fr.L: Alors son compagnon d’esclavage, s’étant jeté à terre, le suppliait en disant : “Sois patient envers moi, et je te rendrai.”
fr.B: Son compagnon de service s’est jeté à terre et l’a supplié : “Accorde-moi un délai, et je te rembourserai.”
fr.R: L’autre serviteur s’est mis à genoux et l’a supplié : “S’il te plaît, sois patient avec moi. Je te rendrai l’argent.”

sw.L: Basi mtumwa mwenzake, akiisha kuanguka, alikuwa akimsihi, akisema, 'Nivumilie, nami nitakulipa.'
sw.B: Mtumishi mwenzake alijitupa chini, akamsihi, 'Nipe muda, nami nitakulipa.'
sw.R: Yule mtumishi mwingine alipiga magoti, akamwomba, 'Tafadhali, nivumilie. Nitakulipa.'

vi.L: Vậy người bạn nô lệ ấy sấp mình xuống nài xin người ấy rằng: 'Xin anh kiên nhẫn với tôi, tôi sẽ trả cho anh.'
vi.B: Người bạn đầy tớ ấy sấp mình xuống van nài: 'Xin anh cho tôi thêm thời gian, tôi sẽ trả cho anh.'
vi.R: Người đầy tớ kia quỳ xuống và van xin: 'Xin anh hãy kiên nhẫn với tôi. Tôi sẽ trả cho anh.'

ko.L: 그러자 그의 동료 종이 엎드려 그에게 간청하며 말했다. '저에게 참아 주십시오. 그러면 제가 갚아 드리겠습니다.'
ko.B: 그러자 동료 종은 땅에 엎드려 애원했다. '조금만 기다려 주십시오. 갚아 드리겠습니다.'
ko.R: 그 동료 종은 무릎을 꿇고 빌었다. '제발 참아 주십시오. 제가 갚겠습니다.'

pt.L: Então o seu companheiro de escravidão, caindo [ao chão], lhe suplicava, dizendo: 'Tenha paciência comigo, e eu lhe pagarei.'
pt.B: O seu companheiro de serviço se jogou ao chão e suplicou: 'Dê-me um prazo, e eu lhe pagarei.'
pt.R: O outro servo se ajoelhou e implorou: 'Por favor, tenha paciência comigo. Eu vou pagar a você.'

am.L: ስለዚህ ባልንጀራው ባሪያ ወድቆ እንዲህ እያለ ይለምነው ነበር፦ “ታገሠኝ፤ እከፍልሃለሁ።”
am.B: ባልንጀራው ባሪያ መሬት ላይ ወድቆ እንዲህ ሲል ለመነው፦ “ጊዜ ስጠኝ፤ መልሼ እከፍልሃለሁ።”
am.R: ሌላው ባሪያም ተንበርክኮ እንዲህ ብሎ ለመነው፦ “እባክህ ታገሠኝ። መልሼ እከፍልሃለሁ።”

ru.L: Тогда его товарищ, пав, умолял его, говоря: “Потерпи меня, и я отдам тебе.”
ru.B: Его товарищ бросился на землю и стал умолять его: “Дай мне время, и я верну тебе.”
ru.R: Другой раб встал на колени и стал умолять его: “Пожалуйста, потерпи. Я отдам тебе.”

hi.L: इसलिए उसका संगी दास गिरकर उससे विनती करता रहा और कहता रहा, 'मुझ पर धीरज रखो, और मैं तुम्हें चुका दूँगा।'
hi.B: उसका संगी दास ज़मीन पर गिर पड़ा और गिड़गिड़ाया, 'मुझे थोड़ा समय दो, मैं तुम्हें लौटा दूँगा।'
hi.R: दूसरा दास घुटनों पर गिर पड़ा और उससे विनती की, 'कृपया मुझ पर धीरज रखो। मैं तुम्हें चुका दूँगा।'

uk.L: Тож його співраб, упавши, благав його, кажучи: “Будь терпеливий до мене, і я віддам тобі.”
uk.B: Його товариш-раб упав на землю й благав його: “Дай мені час, і я поверну тобі.”
uk.R: Інший слуга став на коліна й благав його: “Будь ласка, потерпи. Я віддам тобі.”

ja.L: それで、その仲間の奴隷はひれ伏して、彼に懇願しながら言った。『わたしを辛抱して待ってください。そうすれば、お返しします。』
ja.B: 仲間のしもべはひれ伏して、彼に願った。『どうか待ってください。必ずお返しします。』
ja.R: ほかのしもべはひざまずいて、必死に頼んだ。『どうか、待ってください。お返しします。』

decisions.choice: the same plea as 18:26
decisions.reason: The words are almost those the first slave used to the king, and this debt could in fact be repaid. The echo makes the first slave's refusal plain.

decisions.choice: fell down, the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: fell down at his feet, and "I will pay you everything", the reading of many later manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add "at his feet" and "everything", making the plea match 18:26 more closely. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: the same words as 18:26 at each level
decisions.reason: The echo is kept so that readers hear the same plea.

decisions.choice: servant
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it, and Literal keeps "slave".

decisions.choice: the plea of 18:26 at each level, with "anh" in place of "chủ"
decisions.reason: The same words as the first servant's plea, so the reader hears the echo.

decisions.choice: The same words as 18:26 at each level, in 합쇼체
decisions.reason: The plea is the same as the first servant's (meaning decision), and the English keeps the same words; Korean keeps them too, speech level included, so the reader hears the echo. A debtor begging his creditor naturally uses the deferential style.

source.text: ὁ δὲ οὐκ ἤθελεν, ἀλλὰ ἀπελθὼν ἔβαλεν αὐτὸν εἰς φυλακὴν ἕως οὗ ἀποδῷ τὸ ὀφειλόμενον.

records.literal_gloss: He but not was willing, but having gone away he threw him into prison until he should pay the being owed.

en.L: But he was not willing; instead he went and threw him into prison until he should pay what was owed.
en.B: But he would not hear of it. He went off and had the man put in prison until the debt was paid.
en.R: But the first servant would not wait. He had the other man thrown into prison. He would stay there until he paid back what he owed.

es.L: Pero él no quiso, sino que fue y lo echó en la cárcel hasta que pagara lo que debía.
es.B: Pero él no quiso saber nada. Fue e hizo que lo metieran en la cárcel hasta que pagara la deuda.
es.R: Pero el primer siervo no quiso esperar. Hizo que metieran al otro en la cárcel. Allí se quedaría hasta que pagara lo que debía.

fr.L: Mais lui ne voulait pas ; au contraire, il est allé le jeter en prison jusqu’à ce qu’il ait payé ce qui était dû.
fr.B: Mais il n’a rien voulu entendre. Il est parti et a fait mettre l’homme en prison jusqu’à ce que la dette soit payée.
fr.R: Mais le premier serviteur n’a pas voulu attendre. Il a fait jeter l’autre homme en prison. Celui-ci devait y rester jusqu’à ce qu’il ait rendu ce qu’il devait.

sw.L: Lakini yeye hakutaka, bali alikwenda akamtupa gerezani mpaka atakapolipa kile alichokuwa akidaiwa.
sw.B: Lakini yeye hakukubali hata kidogo. Alikwenda, akaamuru atiwe gerezani mpaka atakapolipa deni.
sw.R: Lakini mtumishi wa kwanza hakutaka kungoja. Alimfanya yule mwingine atupwe gerezani. Angekaa humo mpaka alipe deni lote.

vi.L: Nhưng người ấy không chịu, mà đi bỏ người kia vào ngục cho đến khi trả xong món nợ.
vi.B: Nhưng người ấy không chịu, lại còn đi tống người kia vào ngục cho đến khi trả hết nợ.
vi.R: Nhưng người đầy tớ thứ nhất không chịu chờ. Người ấy cho bắt người kia bỏ tù. Người kia sẽ phải ở tù cho đến khi trả hết số tiền mình nợ.

ko.L: 그러나 그는 원하지 않았다. 오히려 가서, 그가 빚진 것을 갚을 때까지 그를 감옥에 던져 넣었다.
ko.B: 그러나 그는 들어주지 않았다. 오히려 가서, 그 동료가 빚을 다 갚을 때까지 감옥에 가두게 했다.
ko.R: 그러나 빚을 용서받은 그 종은 기다려 주지 않았다. 그는 다른 종을 감옥에 넣게 했다. 빚진 돈을 다 갚을 때까지 감옥에 있게 한 것이다.

pt.L: Mas ele não quis; ao contrário, foi e o lançou na prisão até que pagasse o que devia.
pt.B: Mas ele não quis saber. Foi embora e mandou pôr o homem na prisão até que a dívida fosse paga.
pt.R: Mas o primeiro servo não quis esperar. Ele mandou jogar o outro homem na prisão. Ele ficaria lá até pagar o que devia.

am.L: እርሱ ግን አልፈቀደም፤ ይልቁንም ሄዶ ያለበትን እስኪከፍል ድረስ እስር ቤት ጣለው።
am.B: እርሱ ግን አልተቀበለውም። ሄዶም ዕዳውን እስኪከፍል ድረስ ሰውየውን እስር ቤት አስገባው።
am.R: የመጀመሪያው ባሪያ ግን ሊጠብቀው አልፈለገም። ሌላውን ሰው እስር ቤት አስጣለው። ያለበትን እስኪከፍል ድረስ እዚያ ይቆያል።

ru.L: Но он не захотел, а пошёл и бросил его в тюрьму, пока не отдаст долга.
ru.B: Но тот и слышать об этом не хотел. Он пошёл и добился, чтобы того посадили в тюрьму, пока долг не будет выплачен.
ru.R: Но первый раб не захотел ждать. Он добился, чтобы другого раба бросили в тюрьму. Тот должен был сидеть там, пока не вернёт долг.

hi.L: परंतु वह तैयार नहीं हुआ, बल्कि जाकर उसे कारागार में फिंकवा दिया, जब तक वह बकाया न चुका दे।
hi.B: परंतु उसने एक न सुनी। उसने जाकर उस आदमी को बंदीगृह में डलवा दिया, जब तक कि क़र्ज़ चुका न दिया जाए।
hi.R: पर पहला दास रुकने को तैयार नहीं था। उसने उस दूसरे आदमी को जेल में डलवा दिया। उसे तब तक वहीं रहना था जब तक वह अपना क़र्ज़ न चुका दे।

uk.L: Він же не захотів, а пішов і вкинув його до вʼязниці, доки не віддасть винного.
uk.B: Але той і слухати не хотів. Він пішов і посадив чоловіка до вʼязниці, доки борг не буде сплачено.
uk.R: Але перший слуга не хотів чекати. Він звелів кинути того чоловіка до вʼязниці. Той мав сидіти там, доки не поверне все, що винен.

ja.L: しかし彼は承知せず、出て行って、借りている[もの]を返すまで、その人を牢に投げ入れた。
ja.B: しかし彼は聞き入れず、出て行って、借金を返すまでその人を牢に入れさせた。
ja.R: でも、最初のしもべは待とうとしなかった。その人を牢屋に入れさせ、借りたお金を返すまで出られないようにした。

decisions.choice: prison until he should pay: prison for debt
decisions.reason: As in 5:25-26, a debtor could be held until the debt was paid, often by his family or friends.

decisions.choice: threw him into prison: by legal means, as a creditor could
decisions.reason: The slave would have had the man put in prison through the officials. The wording stresses his harshness.

decisions.choice: had the man put (B); had the other man thrown (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say that he did this through others, following the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: "던져 넣었다" (L); "가두게 했다" (B); "넣게 했다" (R)
decisions.reason: He had him imprisoned by legal means, as a creditor could (meaning decision); Balanced and Readable say he had it done, as the English does.

source.text: ἰδόντες οὖν οἱ σύνδουλοι αὐτοῦ τὰ γενόμενα ἐλυπήθησαν σφόδρα, καὶ ἐλθόντες διεσάφησαν τῷ κυρίῳ ἑαυτῶν πάντα τὰ γενόμενα.

records.literal_gloss: Having seen therefore the fellow slaves of him the things having happened they were grieved greatly, and having come they explained to the master of themselves all the things having happened.

en.L: So when his fellow slaves saw what had happened, they were deeply distressed, and they went and reported to their master all that had happened.
en.B: When the other servants saw what had taken place, they were deeply upset. They went to their master and told him the whole story.
en.R: The other servants saw what happened, and it made them very upset. So they went and told the king everything.

es.L: Entonces sus compañeros de esclavitud, viendo lo sucedido, se entristecieron mucho, y fueron y le explicaron a su señor todo lo sucedido.
es.B: Cuando los demás siervos vieron lo que había pasado, se quedaron muy dolidos. Fueron a su señor y le contaron todo lo ocurrido.
es.R: Los otros siervos vieron lo que pasó y se pusieron muy tristes. Así que fueron y se lo contaron todo al rey.

fr.L: Ses compagnons d’esclavage, ayant donc vu ce qui était arrivé, ont été profondément attristés, et ils sont allés exposer à leur maître tout ce qui était arrivé.
fr.B: Quand les autres serviteurs ont vu ce qui s’était passé, ils ont été profondément bouleversés. Ils sont allés trouver leur maître et lui ont tout raconté.
fr.R: Les autres serviteurs ont vu ce qui s’était passé, et ils ont été très choqués. Alors ils sont allés tout raconter au roi.

sw.L: Basi watumwa wenzake walipoona yaliyotukia, walihuzunika sana, wakaenda, wakamweleza bwana wao yote yaliyotukia.
sw.B: Watumishi wengine walipoona yaliyotokea, walisikitika sana. Wakaenda kwa bwana wao, wakamweleza habari yote.
sw.R: Watumishi wengine waliona yaliyotokea, wakahuzunika sana. Basi wakaenda, wakamwambia mfalme kila kitu.

vi.L: Vậy các bạn nô lệ của người ấy thấy những việc đã xảy ra thì rất buồn rầu, và họ đến thuật lại cho chủ mình mọi việc đã xảy ra.
vi.B: Các đầy tớ khác thấy sự việc như vậy thì rất buồn bực. Họ đến trình bày với chủ mọi việc đã xảy ra.
vi.R: Các đầy tớ khác thấy chuyện ấy thì rất buồn và bực tức. Vì vậy họ đến kể cho vua nghe mọi chuyện.

ko.L: 그러자 그의 동료 종들이 일어난 일들을 보고 몹시 슬퍼했다. 그리고 가서 자기들의 주인에게 일어난 모든 일을 자세히 알렸다.
ko.B: 다른 동료 종들이 이 일을 보고 몹시 마음이 상했다. 그들은 주인에게 가서 일어난 일을 모두 알렸다.
ko.R: 다른 종들이 이 일을 보고 매우 속상했다. 그래서 왕에게 가서 모든 일을 말씀드렸다.

pt.L: Então os companheiros de escravidão dele, vendo o que tinha acontecido, ficaram muito tristes, e foram e relataram ao senhor deles tudo o que tinha acontecido.
pt.B: Quando os outros servos viram o que tinha acontecido, ficaram muito aborrecidos. Foram até o senhor deles e lhe contaram tudo.
pt.R: Os outros servos viram o que aconteceu e ficaram muito aborrecidos. Então foram e contaram tudo ao rei.

am.L: ስለዚህ ባልንጀሮቹ ባሪያዎች የሆነውን ባዩ ጊዜ እጅግ አዘኑ፤ መጥተውም የሆነውን ሁሉ ለጌታቸው ገለጡለት።
am.B: ሌሎቹ ባሪያዎች የሆነውን ባዩ ጊዜ እጅግ ተበሳጩ። ወደ ጌታቸውም ሄደው ነገሩን ሁሉ ነገሩት።
am.R: ሌሎቹ ባሪያዎች የሆነውን አዩ፤ በጣም ተበሳጩም። ስለዚህ ሄደው ለንጉሡ ሁሉንም ነገሩት።

ru.L: Товарищи же его, увидев происшедшее, очень огорчились и, придя, рассказали своему господину всё происшедшее.
ru.B: Когда другие рабы увидели, что произошло, они очень расстроились. Они пошли к своему господину и рассказали ему всё.
ru.R: Другие рабы увидели, что случилось, и очень расстроились. Поэтому они пошли и рассказали царю всё.

hi.L: जो हुआ था उसे देखकर उसके संगी दास बहुत दुःखी हुए, और उन्होंने जाकर अपने स्वामी को सब कुछ जो हुआ था, साफ़-साफ़ बता दिया।
hi.B: जब दूसरे दासों ने यह देखा, तो वे बहुत व्याकुल हुए। उन्होंने अपने स्वामी के पास जाकर सारी बात बता दी।
hi.R: दूसरे दासों ने देखा कि क्या हुआ, और वे बहुत परेशान हो गए। इसलिए उन्होंने जाकर राजा को सब कुछ बता दिया।

uk.L: Тож його співраби, побачивши, що сталося, дуже засмутилися, і, прийшовши, розповіли своєму панові все, що сталося.
uk.B: Коли інші раби побачили, що трапилося, вони дуже обурилися. Вони пішли до свого пана й розповіли йому все.
uk.R: Інші слуги побачили, що сталося, і дуже засмутилися. Тож вони пішли й розповіли цареві все.

ja.L: そこで、彼の仲間の奴隷たちは、起こったことを見て非常に心を痛め、行って、起こったことをすべて自分たちの主人に詳しく告げた。
ja.B: 仲間のしもべたちは、この出来事を見てひどく心を痛めた。そして主人のところに行って、事の次第をすべて話した。
ja.R: ほかのしもべたちは、そのことを見て、とても悲しくなった。それで王のところに行って、何もかも話した。

decisions.choice: deeply distressed: grieved and upset
decisions.reason: The verb means to be grieved or pained. They are troubled at the cruelty they have seen.

decisions.choice: reported: explained in full
decisions.reason: The verb means to make clear. They give the master the whole account.

decisions.choice: the king
decisions.reason: As in 18:25.

decisions.choice: servants
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it, and Literal keeps "slave".

records.literal_gloss: Then having summoned him the master of him says to him, Slave wicked, all the debt that I forgave you, since you begged me;

en.L: Then his master summoned him and says to him, 'Wicked slave! I forgave you all that debt, because you begged me.
en.B: So the master had him called back and said to him, 'Wicked servant! You pleaded with me, and I forgave you the whole of that debt.
en.R: Then the king called the servant in. He said to him, 'You evil servant! You begged me to help you, so I forgave everything you owed me.

es.L: Entonces su señor, llamándolo, le dice: “¡Esclavo malvado! Toda aquella deuda te perdoné, porque me suplicaste.
es.B: Entonces su señor lo mandó llamar y le dijo: “¡Siervo malvado! Tú me suplicaste, y yo te perdoné toda aquella deuda.
es.R: Entonces el rey hizo llamar al siervo y le dijo: “¡Siervo malvado! Tú me rogaste que te ayudara, y por eso te perdoné todo lo que me debías.

fr.L: Alors son maître, l’ayant fait appeler, lui dit : “Méchant esclave ! Toute cette dette, je te l’ai pardonnée, puisque tu m’as supplié.
fr.B: Le maître l’a alors fait rappeler et lui a dit : “Méchant serviteur ! Tu m’as supplié, et je t’ai pardonné toute cette dette.
fr.R: Alors le roi a fait venir le serviteur. Il lui a dit : “Serviteur sans cœur ! Tu m’as supplié de t’aider, alors je t’ai pardonné tout ce que tu me devais.

sw.L: Kisha bwana wake, akiisha kumwita, anamwambia, 'Mtumwa mwovu! Deni lile lote nilikusamehe kwa kuwa uliniomba kwa bidii.
sw.B: Basi bwana wake alimwita, akamwambia, 'Mtumishi mwovu wewe! Ulinisihi, nami nikakusamehe deni lile lote.
sw.R: Kisha mfalme alimwita mtumishi huyo, akamwambia, 'Wewe mtumishi mwovu! Uliniomba nikusaidie, kwa hiyo nikakusamehe deni lako lote.

vi.L: Bấy giờ chủ gọi người ấy đến và nói với người ấy: 'Hỡi tên nô lệ gian ác kia! Ta đã tha thứ cho ngươi tất cả món nợ ấy, vì ngươi đã nài xin ta.
vi.B: Bấy giờ chủ cho gọi người ấy đến và bảo: 'Tên đầy tớ gian ác kia! Ngươi đã nài xin ta, và ta đã tha thứ cho ngươi tất cả món nợ ấy.
vi.R: Rồi vua cho gọi người đầy tớ ấy vào. Vua nói với người ấy: 'Tên đầy tớ độc ác kia! Ngươi đã van xin ta giúp ngươi, nên ta đã tha thứ hết số tiền ngươi nợ ta.

ko.L: 그때에 주인이 그를 불러들여 그에게 말한다. '악한 종아, 네가 나에게 간청하였기에 내가 너에게 그 빚을 모두 용서해 주었다.
ko.B: 그러자 주인은 그 종을 불러다가 말했다. '이 악한 종아! 네가 애원하기에 내가 그 많은 빚을 다 용서해 주었다.
ko.R: 그러자 왕은 그 종을 불러들였다. 그리고 말했다. '이 악한 종아! 네가 도와 달라고 빌었기에, 나는 네 빚을 모두 용서해 주었다.

pt.L: Então o senhor dele, tendo-o chamado, lhe diz: 'Escravo mau! Eu lhe perdoei toda aquela dívida, porque você me suplicou.
pt.B: Então o senhor mandou chamá-lo e lhe disse: 'Servo mau! Você me suplicou, e eu lhe perdoei aquela dívida inteira.
pt.R: Então o rei chamou o servo. Ele disse ao servo: 'Servo malvado! Você me implorou ajuda, e por isso eu perdoei tudo o que você me devia.

am.L: በዚያን ጊዜ ጌታው ጠርቶት እንዲህ ይለዋል፦ “አንተ ክፉ ባሪያ፣ ስለ ለመንኸኝ ያን ዕዳ ሁሉ ይቅር አልኩህ፤
am.B: ስለዚህ ጌታው አስጠርቶት እንዲህ አለው፦ “አንተ ክፉ ባሪያ! ለመንኸኝ፤ እኔም ያን ዕዳ ሁሉ ይቅር አልኩህ።
am.R: ከዚያም ንጉሡ ባሪያውን ጠራው። እንዲህም አለው፦ “አንተ ክፉ ባሪያ! እንድረዳህ ለመንኸኝ፤ ስለዚህ ያለብህን ሁሉ ይቅር አልኩህ።

ru.L: Тогда господин, призвав его, говорит ему: “Раб негодный! Весь тот долг я простил тебе, раз ты умолял меня.
ru.B: Тогда господин велел позвать его и сказал ему: “Злой раб! Ты умолял меня, и я простил тебе весь этот долг.
ru.R: Тогда царь позвал раба к себе. Он сказал ему: “Злой раб! Ты умолял меня помочь тебе, и я простил тебе всё, что ты мне был должен.

hi.L: तब उसका स्वामी उसे बुलाकर उससे कहता है, 'हे दुष्ट दास! मैंने तुम्हारा वह सारा क़र्ज़ क्षमा कर दिया, क्योंकि तुमने मुझसे विनती की थी।
hi.B: तब स्वामी ने उसे वापस बुलवाया और कहा, 'दुष्ट दास! तुमने मुझसे विनती की थी, और मैंने तुम्हारा वह पूरा क़र्ज़ क्षमा कर दिया।
hi.R: तब राजा ने उस दास को अंदर बुलाया। उसने उससे कहा, 'तुम दुष्ट दास हो! तुमने मुझसे मदद की विनती की, इसलिए मैंने तुम्हारा सारा क़र्ज़ क्षमा कर दिया।

uk.L: Тоді його пан, покликавши його, каже йому: “Рабе лукавий! Увесь той борг я простив тобі, бо ти благав мене.
uk.B: Тоді пан знову покликав його і сказав йому: “Злий рабе! Ти благав мене, і я простив тобі весь той борг.
uk.R: Тоді цар покликав того слугу. Він сказав йому: “Ти злий слуго! Ти благав мене про допомогу, і я простив тобі все, що ти був мені винен.

ja.L: そこで主人は彼を呼びつけて言う。『悪い奴隷よ、おまえがわたしに懇願したから、わたしはあの借金をすべておまえに赦してやったのだ。
ja.B: そこで主人はそのしもべを呼びつけて言った。『悪いしもべよ、おまえが願ったから、わたしはあの借金を全部赦してやったのだ。
ja.R: そこで王は、そのしもべを呼んで言った。『悪いしもべだ！おまえが助けてくれと頼んだから、わたしは借金を全部ゆるしてやったのだ。

decisions.choice: wicked: evil, here cruel and without mercy
decisions.reason: The word is the usual one for evil. His wickedness is his hardness toward a fellow slave after he had been shown mercy.

decisions.choice: because you begged me: the debt was forgiven only because he asked
decisions.reason: The slave did nothing to earn it. He only asked, and the king forgave.

decisions.choice: present tense of narration (L); past (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek present tense of narration.

decisions.choice: the master's words open here and close at the end of 18:33
alternatives: closing the inner quotation at the end of this sentence
decisions.reason: The master's rebuke runs over two sentences, so the inner quotation stays open.

decisions.choice: to help you
decisions.reason: Readable says what he begged for.

decisions.choice: servant
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it, and Literal keeps "slave".

decisions.choice: the master says "ta" (lowercase, no span) and calls the servant "ngươi" (18:32-33)
decisions.reason: A king rebuking a servant; as in 13:28, a master in a parable takes no deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: The king speaks to the servant in 해라체; present "말한다" (L)
decisions.reason: A king rebuking his slave speaks plainly; Literal keeps Matthew's present tense of narration.

decisions.reason: The master's rebuke runs over two sentences, so the inner bracket stays open, as in the English.

records.literal_gloss: Not was it necessary also you to have mercy on the fellow slave of you, as also I you had mercy?

en.L: Should you not also have had mercy on your fellow slave, as I also had mercy on you?'
en.B: Should you not have shown your fellow servant the same mercy I showed you?'
en.R: You should have shown mercy to the other servant, just as I showed mercy to you.'

es.L: ¿No era necesario que también tú tuvieras misericordia de tu compañero de esclavitud, como también yo tuve misericordia de ti?”.
es.B: ¿No debías haber tratado a tu compañero con la misma misericordia con que yo te traté a ti?”.
es.R: Tú también debías haber tenido misericordia del otro siervo, como yo la tuve de ti”.

fr.L: Ne fallait-il pas que toi aussi tu aies pitié de ton compagnon d’esclavage, comme moi aussi j’ai eu pitié de toi ?”
fr.B: Ne devais-tu pas, toi aussi, avoir pour ton compagnon de service la même pitié que j’ai eue pour toi ?”
fr.R: Tu aurais dû avoir pitié de l’autre serviteur, comme j’ai eu pitié de toi.”

sw.L: Je, haikukupasa wewe pia kumhurumia mtumwa mwenzako, kama nami nilivyokuhurumia wewe?'
sw.B: Je, hukupaswa kumwonea mtumishi mwenzako huruma ile ile niliyokuonea mimi?'
sw.R: Ulipaswa kumhurumia mtumishi mwenzako, kama mimi nilivyokuhurumia wewe.'

vi.L: Chẳng phải ngươi cũng nên thương xót bạn nô lệ của ngươi, như ta cũng đã thương xót ngươi sao?'
vi.B: Chẳng lẽ ngươi không nên thương xót bạn đầy tớ của ngươi như ta đã thương xót ngươi sao?'
vi.R: Ngươi đáng lẽ cũng phải thương xót người đầy tớ kia, như ta đã thương xót ngươi.'

ko.L: 내가 너를 불쌍히 여긴 것처럼, 너도 네 동료 종을 불쌍히 여겨야 하지 않았느냐?'
ko.B: 내가 너에게 자비를 베푼 것처럼, 너도 네 동료 종에게 자비를 베풀었어야 하지 않느냐?'
ko.R: 내가 너에게 자비를 베푼 것처럼, 너도 다른 종에게 자비를 베풀었어야 했다.'

pt.L: Não devia você também ter tido misericórdia do seu companheiro de escravidão, assim como eu tive misericórdia de você?'
pt.B: Você não devia ter mostrado ao seu companheiro de serviço a mesma misericórdia que eu mostrei a você?'
pt.R: Você devia ter tido misericórdia do outro servo, assim como eu tive misericórdia de você.'

am.L: እኔ አንተን እንደ ማርኩህ አንተስ ደግሞ ባልንጀራህን ባሪያ ልትምረው አይገባህም ነበር?”
am.B: እኔ ለአንተ ያሳየሁህን ምሕረት አንተም ለባልንጀራህ ባሪያ ልታሳይ አይገባህም ነበር?”
am.R: እኔ ለአንተ ምሕረት እንዳሳየሁህ አንተም ለሌላው ባሪያ ምሕረት ማሳየት ነበረብህ።”

ru.L: Не должен ли был и ты пожалеть своего товарища-раба, как и я тебя пожалел?”
ru.B: Разве не должен был ты оказать своему товарищу такую же милость, какую я оказал тебе?”
ru.R: Ты должен был пожалеть другого раба, так же как я пожалел тебя.”

hi.L: क्या तुम्हें भी अपने संगी दास पर दया नहीं करनी चाहिए थी, जैसे मैंने भी तुम पर दया की?'
hi.B: क्या तुम्हें भी अपने संगी दास पर वैसी ही दया नहीं दिखानी चाहिए थी जैसी मैंने तुम पर दिखाई?'
hi.R: तुम्हें भी उस दूसरे दास पर दया दिखानी चाहिए थी, जैसे मैंने तुम पर दया दिखाई।'

uk.L: Чи не належало й тобі змилуватися над своїм співрабом, як і я змилувався над тобою?”
uk.B: Чи не мав і ти виявити своєму товаришеві-рабу таку саму милість, яку я виявив тобі?”
uk.R: Ти мав виявити милість до іншого слуги, так само як я виявив милість до тебе.”

ja.L: わたしがおまえをあわれんだように、おまえも自分の仲間の奴隷をあわれむべきではなかったのか？』
ja.B: わたしがおまえをあわれんだように、おまえも仲間のしもべをあわれむべきではなかったか？』
ja.R: わたしがおまえをあわれんだのと同じように、おまえもほかのしもべをあわれむべきだったのだ。』

decisions.choice: should you not: a question that expects "yes"
decisions.reason: The form expects agreement. He was bound to show the mercy he had received.

decisions.choice: as I had mercy on you: mercy received calls for mercy given
alternatives: mercy as a reward for mercy
decisions.reason: This is the point of the story: those who have been forgiven must forgive. Compare 5:7 and 6:12.

decisions.choice: a statement instead of a question
alternatives: Should you not have had mercy?
decisions.reason: The question expects "yes"; Readable gives the answer.

decisions.choice: servant
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it, and Literal keeps "slave".

decisions.choice: "불쌍히 여기다" (L); "자비를 베풀다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the verb of the Korean Matthew's "have mercy on me" (9:27; 15:22); Balanced and Readable use the settled noun "자비".

source.text: καὶ ὀργισθεὶς ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ παρέδωκεν αὐτὸν τοῖς βασανισταῖς ἕως οὗ ἀποδῷ πᾶν τὸ ὀφειλόμενον.

records.literal_gloss: And having been angry the master of him handed over him to the torturers until he should pay all the being owed.

en.L: And in anger his master handed him over to the torturers until he should pay all that was owed.
en.B: Then the master, now angry, gave him over to the torturers, to stay with them until he had repaid the whole debt.
en.R: The king was very angry. He handed the servant over to men who would torture him in prison. He would stay there until he paid back everything he owed.

es.L: Y enojado, su señor lo entregó a los torturadores hasta que pagara todo lo que debía.
es.B: Entonces su señor, ya enfurecido, lo entregó a los torturadores, y allí se quedaría hasta que pagara toda la deuda.
es.R: El rey se enojó mucho. Entregó al siervo a unos hombres que lo torturarían en la cárcel. Allí se quedaría hasta que pagara todo lo que debía.

fr.L: Et son maître, mis en colère, l’a livré aux tortionnaires jusqu’à ce qu’il ait payé tout ce qui était dû.
fr.B: Alors le maître, en colère, l’a livré aux bourreaux, jusqu’à ce qu’il ait remboursé toute la dette.
fr.R: Le roi était très en colère. Il a livré le serviteur à des hommes qui allaient le torturer en prison. Il devait y rester jusqu’à ce qu’il ait rendu tout ce qu’il devait.

sw.L: Na bwana wake, akiwa amekasirika, alimkabidhi kwa watesaji mpaka atakapolipa yote aliyokuwa akidaiwa.
sw.B: Basi bwana wake, sasa akiwa na hasira, alimtia mikononi mwa watesaji, akae nao mpaka alipe deni lote.
sw.R: Mfalme alikasirika sana. Alimkabidhi mtumishi huyo kwa watu ambao wangemtesa gerezani. Angekaa humo mpaka alipe deni lote.

vi.L: Và chủ người ấy nổi giận, giao người ấy cho những kẻ tra tấn cho đến khi trả xong tất cả món nợ.
vi.B: Rồi chủ nổi giận, giao người ấy cho bọn cai ngục tra tấn cho đến khi trả hết món nợ.
vi.R: Vua rất giận. Vua giao người đầy tớ ấy cho những người sẽ hành hạ người ấy trong ngục. Người ấy sẽ phải ở đó cho đến khi trả hết số tiền mình nợ.

ko.L: 그리고 그의 주인은 노하여, 그가 빚진 것을 다 갚을 때까지 그를 고문하는 사람들에게 넘겨주었다.
ko.B: 주인은 화가 나서, 그 종이 빚을 다 갚을 때까지 고문하는 간수들에게 넘겨주었다.
ko.R: 왕은 몹시 화가 났다. 그래서 그 종을 감옥에서 고문하는 사람들에게 넘겨주었다. 그 종은 빚을 다 갚을 때까지 거기에 있어야 했다.

pt.L: E, irado, o senhor dele o entregou aos torturadores até que pagasse tudo o que devia.
pt.B: Então o senhor, agora irado, o entregou aos torturadores, para ficar com eles até pagar a dívida inteira.
pt.R: O rei ficou com muita raiva. Ele entregou o servo a homens que iriam torturá-lo na prisão. Ele ficaria lá até pagar tudo o que devia.

am.L: ጌታውም ተቆጥቶ ያለበትን ሁሉ እስኪከፍል ድረስ ለአሠቃዮች አሳልፎ ሰጠው።
am.B: ጌታውም ተቆጥቶ ዕዳውን ሁሉ እስኪከፍል ድረስ እንዲቆይ ለአሠቃዮች አሳልፎ ሰጠው።
am.R: ንጉሡ በጣም ተቆጣ። ባሪያውን በእስር ቤት ለሚያሠቃዩት ሰዎች አሳልፎ ሰጠው። ያለበትን ሁሉ እስኪከፍል ድረስ እዚያ ይቆያል።

ru.L: И, разгневавшись, господин его отдал его истязателям, пока он не отдаст всего долга.
ru.B: Тогда разгневанный господин отдал его истязателям, пока тот не выплатит весь долг.
ru.R: Царь очень рассердился. Он отдал раба людям, которые мучили бы его в тюрьме. Тот должен был оставаться там, пока не вернёт всё, что должен.

hi.L: और उसके स्वामी ने क्रोध में आकर उसे यातना देनेवालों के हाथ सौंप दिया, जब तक वह सारा बकाया न चुका दे।
hi.B: तब स्वामी ने क्रोधित होकर उसे यातना देनेवालों के हवाले कर दिया, कि जब तक वह सारा क़र्ज़ न लौटा दे, तब तक उन्हीं के पास रहे।
hi.R: राजा को बहुत ग़ुस्सा आया। उसने उस दास को उन लोगों के हवाले कर दिया जो जेल में उसे यातना देते। उसे तब तक वहीं रहना था जब तक वह अपना सारा क़र्ज़ न चुका दे।

uk.L: І, розгнівавшись, його пан віддав його катам, доки не віддасть усього винного.
uk.B: Тоді розгніваний пан віддав його катам, і той мав бути в них, доки не поверне всього боргу.
uk.R: Цар дуже розгнівався. Він віддав слугу людям, які мали мучити його у вʼязниці. Той мав бути там, доки не поверне все, що винен.

ja.L: そして主人は怒って、借りている[もの]をすべて返すまで、彼を拷問する者たちに引き渡した。
ja.B: 主人は怒り、借金をすべて返すまで、そのしもべを拷問する役人たちに引き渡した。
ja.R: 王はひどく怒った。そして、そのしもべを、牢屋で痛めつける役人たちに引き渡した。借りたお金を全部返すまで、そこから出られないようにしたのだ。

decisions.choice: the torturers: jailers who used torture
decisions.reason: The word means those who torture. Torture was sometimes used on prisoners to make them or their families pay.

decisions.choice: until he should pay all: a debt that could never be paid
decisions.reason: The debt was beyond paying (18:24), so the words point to punishment without release. Jesus applies it in 18:35.

decisions.choice: in anger: the king's anger at the slave's cruelty
decisions.reason: The master was angry because the slave had not shown mercy, not because of the money (18:33).

decisions.choice: men who would torture him in prison
decisions.reason: Readable says who the torturers were.

decisions.choice: "những kẻ tra tấn" (L); "bọn cai ngục tra tấn" (B); "những người sẽ hành hạ người ấy trong ngục" (R)
decisions.reason: The torturers were jailers who used torture; Balanced and Readable say who they were.

decisions.choice: "고문하는 사람들" (L, R); "고문하는 간수들" (B)
decisions.reason: The torturers were jailers who used torture (meaning decision); Balanced names them as jailers.

source.text: Οὕτως καὶ ὁ πατήρ μου ὁ οὐράνιος ποιήσει ὑμῖν ἐὰν μὴ ἀφῆτε ἕκαστος τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τῶν καρδιῶν ὑμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: So also the Father of me the heavenly will do to you if not you forgive each the brother of him from the hearts of you.

en.L: So also {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} heavenly Father will do to you, if you do not each forgive {{gender:your brother or sister|your brother}} from your hearts."
en.B: My Father in heaven will deal with you in the same way if you do not forgive {{gender:your brother or sister|your brother}} from the heart, each one of you."
en.R: And {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Father in heaven will do the same to you if you do not truly forgive {{gender:your brother or sister|your brother}} from your heart."

es.L: Así también {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Padre celestial hará con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, si no {{plural_you:perdonan|perdonáis}} cada uno a {{gender:su hermano o hermana|su hermano}} de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} corazones».
es.B: Así tratará también {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Padre que está en el cielo a cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, si no perdona de corazón a {{gender:su hermano o hermana|su hermano}}».
es.R: Y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Padre que está en el cielo hará lo mismo con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} si cada uno no perdona de verdad, de todo corazón, a {{gender:su hermano o hermana|su hermano}}».

fr.L: C’est ainsi que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père céleste vous traitera aussi, si vous ne pardonnez pas, chacun, à {{gender:son frère ou sa sœur|son frère}} du fond de vos cœurs. »
fr.B: Mon Père qui est dans le ciel agira de la même manière envers vous si chacun de vous ne pardonne pas à {{gender:son frère ou sa sœur|son frère}} du fond du cœur. »
fr.R: Et {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père qui est au ciel vous traitera de la même façon si vous ne pardonnez pas vraiment, du fond du cœur, à {{gender:votre frère ou votre sœur|votre frère}}. »

sw.L: Ndivyo atakavyowatendea ninyi pia Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} wa mbinguni, ikiwa hamtamsamehe kila mmoja ndugu yake kutoka ndani ya mioyo yenu."
sw.B: Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} aliye mbinguni atawatendea vivyo hivyo, ikiwa kila mmoja wenu hatamsamehe ndugu yake kwa moyo wote."
sw.R: Naye Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} aliye mbinguni atawatendea vivyo hivyo kama kila mmoja wenu hatamsamehe ndugu yake kwa kweli, kutoka moyoni."

vi.L: Cha {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở trên trời cũng sẽ làm như vậy với các con, nếu mỗi người trong các con không tha thứ cho {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} mình từ trong lòng."
vi.B: Cha {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở trên trời cũng sẽ đối xử với các con như vậy, nếu mỗi người trong các con không hết lòng tha thứ cho {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} mình."
vi.R: Cha {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở trên trời cũng sẽ làm như thế với các con nếu các con không thật lòng tha thứ cho {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} mình."

ko.L: 너희가 각자 마음으로부터 자기 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}를 용서하지 않으면, 내 하늘 아버지께서도 너희에게 이와 같이 하실 것이다."
ko.B: 너희가 저마다 진심으로 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}를 용서하지 않으면, 하늘에 계신 내 아버지께서도 너희에게 이와 같이 하실 것이다."
ko.R: 너희가 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}를 진심으로 용서하지 않으면, 하늘에 계신 내 아버지께서도 너희에게 똑같이 하실 것이다."

pt.L: Assim também o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Pai celestial fará a vocês, se cada um de vocês não perdoar de coração ao seu {{gender:irmão ou irmã|irmão}}."
pt.B: O {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Pai, que está no céu, vai tratar vocês da mesma forma, se cada um de vocês não perdoar de coração ao seu {{gender:irmão ou irmã|irmão}}."
pt.R: E o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Pai, que está no céu, vai fazer o mesmo com vocês se cada um de vocês não perdoar de verdade, de todo o coração, o seu {{gender:irmão ou irmã|irmão}}."

am.L: ከእናንተ እያንዳንዱ {{gender:ወንድሙን ወይም እኅቱን|ወንድሙን}} ከልባችሁ ይቅር ባትሉ የሰማዩ አባቴም እንዲሁ ያደርግባችኋል።»
am.B: እያንዳንዳችሁ {{gender:ወንድማችሁን ወይም እኅታችሁን|ወንድማችሁን}} ከልብ ይቅር ባትሉ በሰማይ ያለው አባቴም እንዲሁ ያደርግባችኋል።»
am.R: እናንተም {{gender:ወንድማችሁን ወይም እኅታችሁን|ወንድማችሁን}} በእውነት ከልባችሁ ይቅር ባትሉ በሰማይ ያለው አባቴ እንዲሁ ያደርግባችኋል።»

ru.L: Так и {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} Небесный Отец поступит с вами, если каждый из вас не простит {{gender:своего брата или сестру|своего брата}} от сердец ваших.»
ru.B: Мой Отец Небесный поступит с вами так же, если каждый из вас не простит {{gender:своего брата или сестру|своего брата}} от всего сердца.»
ru.R: И {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} Отец на небесах поступит с вами так же, если вы не простите {{gender:своего брата или сестру|своего брата}} по-настоящему, от всего сердца.»

hi.L: इसी प्रकार मेरे स्वर्गीय पिता भी तुम्हारे साथ करेंगे, यदि तुममें से हर एक अपने {{gender:भाई या बहन|भाई}} को अपने हृदय से क्षमा न करे।"
hi.B: यदि तुममें से हर एक अपने {{gender:भाई या बहन|भाई}} को मन से क्षमा नहीं करता, तो मेरे स्वर्गीय पिता भी तुम्हारे साथ ऐसा ही व्यवहार करेंगे।"
hi.R: और अगर तुम अपने {{gender:भाई या बहन|भाई}} को सच्चे दिल से क्षमा नहीं करते, तो स्वर्ग में रहनेवाले मेरे पिता भी तुम्हारे साथ ऐसा ही करेंगे।"

uk.L: Так і {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} Небесний Отець зробить вам, якщо не простите кожен {{gender:своєму братові чи сестрі|своєму братові}} від ваших сердець.»
uk.B: Так само вчинить із вами й {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} Отець, що на небі, якщо кожен із вас не простить від серця {{gender:своєму братові чи сестрі|своєму братові}}.»
uk.R: І {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} Отець на небі зробить так само з вами, якщо ви не простите щиро, від серця, {{gender:своєму братові чи сестрі|своєму братові}}.»

ja.L: もしあなたがたが、それぞれ自分の{{gender:きょうだい|兄弟}}を心から赦さないなら、わたしの天の父も、あなたがたに同じようになさるのである。」
ja.B: あなたがたの一人一人が、自分の{{gender:きょうだい|兄弟}}を心から赦さないなら、天におられるわたしの父も、あなたがたに同じようになさるであろう。」
ja.R: あなたたちも、自分の{{gender:きょうだい|兄弟}}を本当に心からゆるさないなら、天におられるわたしの父も、あなたたちに同じことをなさるのだ。」

decisions.choice: so also my Father will do: God will judge the unforgiving
alternatives: God's forgiveness is earned by forgiving others
decisions.reason: As in 6:14-15, forgiveness received and forgiveness given belong together. One who refuses to forgive shows that he has not taken God's mercy to heart.

decisions.choice: from your hearts: truly, from within
decisions.reason: In Scripture the heart is the center of thought and will (5:28). Forgiveness must be real, not only in words.

decisions.choice: brother: a fellow disciple, man or woman
{{gender:your brother or sister|your brother}}
decisions.reason: As in 18:15, the inclusive form is the default.

decisions.choice: the quotation closes here
decisions.reason: The speech that began in 18:22 ends here, and with it the fourth long speech in Matthew. 19:1 returns to the story.

decisions.choice: in heaven
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the form of 6:9 and 18:10.

decisions.choice: cada uno ... a su hermano
decisions.reason: With "cada uno" (each one) as the subject, "su hermano" is right for both ustedes and vosotros readers, so the brother needs no plural_you span; "de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} corazones" in Literal does.

decisions.choice: "Cha Ta ở trên trời" (L) for "my heavenly Father"
alternatives: "Cha Ta, Đấng ở trên các tầng trời"
decisions.reason: The Greek here has the adjective "heavenly", not "who is in the heavens", so Literal does not use the longer phrase it keeps for that wording.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} mình"
decisions.reason: As in 18:15: a fellow disciple, man or woman.

decisions.choice: "내 하늘 아버지" (L); "하늘에 계신 내 아버지" (B, R); "마음으로부터" (L), "진심으로" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the adjective "heavenly" as the Korean Matthew 6:14 and 15:13 do. From the heart means truly (meaning decision). Korean puts the condition first, as its word order needs; the quotation closes here.

decisions.choice: the condition first, then "父も……同じようになさる"
decisions.reason: Japanese puts the condition before the main clause; the sense of "so also my Father will do" is kept at the end.
